ideas.name: Weapon revamp
ideas.description: Revamp of base moveset, new moveset on ROLL JUMP PARRY, unique move per weapon type
ideas.sketch: Define a move table keyed by weapon skill or animation state, with context moves: riposte after a successful parry, roll-strike within N s of a dodge, plunge while airborne. A Humanoid.StartAttack prefix checks context timers set in BlockAttack/UpdateDodge/OnJump postfixes and swaps in a cloned Attack template, using a vanilla trigger from another weapon family or a custom Animator trigger. Per-move damage, stagger and adrenaline are set through Attack fields.
ideas.risks: Trigger names must exist in every client's Animator, and missing ones fail silently. New clips need an AssetBundle and Animator pipeline that can clash with attack-speed or emote mods. ClearActionQueue on attack start interacts with reload and equip queues. EpicLoot and weapon-pack mods patch Attack and Humanoid heavily. Balance and PvP fairness need server-synced config.

existingMods.name: Goo's Combat Overhaul (gnls)
existingMods.notes: Souls-like overhaul: running and jump attacks per weapon type, hyperarmor modes, stagger rework, positional bonuses, YAML per-weapon profiles, ConditionalConfigSync. Reuses vanilla animations. Closed source. About 8.4K downloads.

existingMods.name: SecondaryAttacks (sighsorry)
existingMods.notes: New secondary attacks for all weapon classes and blood magic. YAML per-prefab overrides, list of usable animations, quickstep for knives and fists. About 12K downloads.

existingMods.name: AttackCancleCounter (IDRdhnTM)
existingMods.notes: Cancel an attack mid-animation into a parry or dodge; counter while chaining. Related: Valheim Legends 1.0 port (Duelist Riposte) and GrindstoneSkills (buffed attack after a parry).

ideas.inspiration: Borrow GCO's input detection (running attack = attack above a speed threshold, jump attack = attack before landing) and its YAML per-weapon profiles, plus SpecialAttack's skill-gated unlocks. What existing mods get wrong: they overload the secondary attack or add keys, spawn un-Valheim projectile VFX, and bundle stamina, PvP and AI changes. Ours: moves that depend on context using vanilla inputs (roll-attack, plunge from a jump, riposte in the window after a perfect block), exactly one signature move per weapon type, built on vanilla SharedData attack data and existing animator states, and fed by the adrenaline revamp (Humanoid.BlockAttack already grants perfect-block adrenaline).

ideas.name: Sneak revamp
ideas.description: gain xp on sneak attack, make ennemies spot you less easily early
ideas.sketch: Prefix Character.Damage, which runs on the attacker's machine. If the attacker is the local player, the target's BaseAI is not alerted (synced from ZDO alert) and backstabBonus > 1, raise Sneak and remember the victim for 300 s. Postfix Player.UpdateStealth to multiply the stealth target by a bonus that fades with Sneak skill or boss progression, and scale noise in RPC_AddNoise. Both values sync through ZDO, so the change stays client-only.
ideas.risks: Attacker-side prediction can diverge from the victim-owner backstab rule (per-victim cooldown, PassiveMobs sight check); an optional owner-to-attacker RPC can fix this when both sides have the mod. Changing monster view angle or range would need everyone to install it. Other stealth-overhaul or EpicLoot sneak effects patch the same methods.

existingMods.name: SmartSkills (Smoothbrain)
existingMods.notes: Sneak raises backstab damage and gives bonus Sneak XP on a backstab. Open source (blaxxun-boop/SmartSkills). About 120K downloads.

existingMods.status: v1.1.8, updated 2026-09-15, tagged Deep North (1.0: yes)
existingMods.notes: Sneak movement speed scales with skill; XP multiplier; ServerSync. About 138K downloads.

existingMods.name: Valheim Combat Overhaul (Kyresel/leseryk)
existingMods.notes: Implemented exactly this idea: XP for stealth attacks scaled by backstab bonus, and easier early-game sneaking. Now dead (Nexus 591).

existingMods.name: Goo's Combat Overhaul (gnls)
existingMods.notes: Sneak positional damage bonus against unaware targets, scaling with skill.

ideas.inspiration: Vanilla only grants Sneak XP from moving while sneaking (Player.UpdateStealth). The backstab applies only to unalerted creatures, with a 300 s cooldown per creature, and the stealth factor lerp is harsh at skill 0. Ours: XP on backstab scaled by creature tier or damage, a flatter low-skill detection curve (bonus at night or in cover), and clearer feedback on the stealth HUD. Essentially Kyresel's dead design, maintained and server-synced.

ideas.name: Trinket revamp
ideas.description: Change how the trinket effect works (probably passiv + adrenaline boost)
ideas.sketch: On ObjectDB init, give every ItemType.Trinket a passive m_equipStatusEffect (a scaled clone of its full-adrenaline SE, or a hand-authored SE_Stats). Keep or boost m_fullAdrenalineSE as the burst. Optionally use a custom SE_Stats subclass whose Modify* overrides scale with Player.GetAdrenaline()/GetMaxAdrenaline().
ideas.risks: SharedData edits are global and must be reapplied on every ObjectDB init. NG+ world-level equip restrictions still apply. EpicLoot trinket support and other trinket rebalance mods may conflict. Should be designed together with the Adrenaline revamp. Server-synced config is recommended for fairness.

existingMods.name: BetterTrinkets (Schwifty)
existingMods.notes: The exact concept: trinket effects always on as a weaker passive, and full adrenaline doubles the effect for the normal duration. Config for all 13 trinkets. Client-side only (balance concern). About 2.6K downloads.

existingMods.name: MultiTrinket (QQMZR)
existingMods.notes: For extra trinket-slot mods: uses the highest adrenaline cost and triggers all equipped trinkets together. Source: github.com/MoistMonster22/MultiTrinket.

existingMods.name: ClassTrinkets (JamesJonesTV)
existingMods.notes: 40 new static-stat trinkets (8 classes x 5 ranks). New content, not a mechanic rework.

ideas.inspiration: Vanilla: trinkets add max adrenaline (SharedData.m_maxAdrenaline) and have an m_fullAdrenalineSE. Player.AddAdrenaline applies it to every equipped item and resets the bar. Player.m_adrenalineEffects already supports tiered status effects by adrenaline level. Borrow BetterTrinkets' passive-plus-surge split, but make it server-authoritative, show both effects in the tooltip, maybe add partial-bar tiers, and design it together with the adrenaline and boss-power revamps.

ideas.name: Adrenaline revamp
ideas.description: It sucks, change it
ideas.sketch: Route all gains through a prefix on Player.AddAdrenaline, with a source-context flag set by prefixes on the source methods. Apply a mod-defined gain table, drop the miss and unblocked-hit penalties, and disable the automatic pop. Add explicit spenders, such as empowered context attacks or guardian-power activation, and optional tier SEs via m_adrenalineEffects.
ideas.risks: Degen, delay and gain curves and base m_maxAdrenaline are prefab data and must be dumped first. Adrenaline is not saved. The Game.m_adrenalineRate world modifier still applies. It overlaps with the trinket, boss power and weapon revamps, so a shared library is needed.

existingMods.name: AdrenalineModifier (mightywa33ior)
existingMods.notes: Numeric multipliers only: growth, decay and decay delay. Source: github.com/lukeadickinson/valhiem-adrenalinemodifier.

existingMods.name: BetterTrinkets (Schwifty)
existingMods.notes: Makes adrenaline a bonus on top of passive trinkets instead of a gate.

existingMods.name: ForsakenPowerOverhaul (momos3939)
existingMods.notes: Guardian power activation triggers the adrenaline boost.

ideas.inspiration: Vanilla adrenaline is data-driven: AnimationCurves on Player (m_adrenalineDegen, m_adrenalineDegenDelay, m_adrenalineGainMultiplier), the world multiplier Game.m_adrenalineRate, SE_Stats m_adrenalineModifier and m_adrenalineUpFront, per-action gains (m_staggerEnemyAdrenaline, perfect-block adrenaline), and +10 on guardian power activation. That is why existing mods only tweak numbers. Nobody has redesigned the loop. Ours: earn adrenaline from skilled, risky play (perfect blocks and dodges, backstabs, staggers), slow the decay in combat, optionally spend it on purpose (weapon signature move, trinket surge), and use one shared resource for trinkets, boss powers and weapon moves.

ideas.name: Boss power revamp
ideas.description: Same as trinkets

A StartGuardianPower prefix makes activation consume adrenaline instead of waiting for m_guardianPowerCooldown, with stronger effects at full adrenaline. Custom shared SEs are registered in ObjectDB.
ideas.risks: Custom GP SEs are added by hash to nearby players, so everyone needs the mod in that case. GP asset names (GP_Fader) differ from the stat switch (GP_Ashlands). The cooldown is saved in the profile. It interacts with the Adrenaline revamp (activation already gives +10). Mods that tweak GP cooldown or duration conflict.

ideas.name: Balista revamp
ideas.description: Better AI, target assignement
ideas.sketch: Replace the closest-creature pick with a score: threat (targeting a player or a structure), low HP, distance, and a claim cap derived from other turrets' networked targets (RPC_SetTarget reaches everybody). Keep the current target unless a much better one appears. Sphere-cast the line of fire to skip shots that would hit players, tames or walls. Add gravity compensation using Projectile.m_gravity. Make HitType.Turret bolts ignore players and tames in Projectile.IsValidTarget.
ideas.risks: Turret logic runs on whichever client owns the turret, so claim logic must use networked data only. Performance with many turrets requires throttling. Must not break ammo and trophy targeting. Turret-adding mods inherit the patch, so filter by config.

existingMods.name: BetterBallistas (Neobotics)
existingMods.notes: Toggle enemy, tame and player targeting; range; arc up to 180 degrees; ammo cap; unlocks the one-trophy limit; scan and turn tuning. About 21K downloads.

existingMods.name: Turrets Redo (MrGay)
existingMods.notes: Lead shots from velocity and projectile speed, spread control, ignores friendlies with optional projectile immunity. Tagged AI Generated, about 200 downloads.

existingMods.name: ValheimFortress (MidnightMods)
existingMods.notes: Wave-arena mod; its ballistas shoot whenever the shot would hit any hostile, not only the primary target.

existingMods.name: ImFRIENDLY DAMMIT (Azumatt)
existingMods.notes: Ballistas never hit you or your tames.

ideas.inspiration: Vanilla Turret has target flags, a trophy filter (m_maxConfigTargets = 1), a basic m_predictionModifier and near/far update intervals (Turret.UpdateTarget). Missing everywhere: a shared target registry so neighbouring ballistas spread fire, priority rules (closest, threat, attacking a structure, low HP) and line-of-fire checks against friendly pieces. Borrow lead prediction (Turrets Redo) and 'shoot if the path hits any hostile' (ValheimFortress).

ideas.name: Mob AI revamp
ideas.description: (run away when scared, avoid player when strong, stop being stuck when rooted / frozen etc)
ideas.sketch: Attach a brain component in a MonsterAI.Awake postfix. It computes fear from HP%, recent damage, allies and fire, plus player strength from ZDO-synced data: max_health, VisEquipment item hashes mapped to ObjectDB stats, and boss keys vs biome. When fearful, a MonsterAI.UpdateAI prefix calls the reverse-patched BaseAI.UpdateAI and Flee, then returns false. A BaseAI.MoveTo postfix detects not-rooted-but-not-moving (StandStillDuration) and forces a repath, side-step or jump. While rooted, it suppresses the can't-reach timers and prefers ranged weapons.
ideas.risks: UpdateAI is long and changes between versions, so use small prefixes and reverse patches rather than copies. It runs at 20 Hz times many mobs, so avoid allocations. The SEs and inventory of remote players are invisible to the AI owner. Conflicts with creature overhauls (RRR, CLLC, MonsterLabZ, Therzie Monstrum). Bosses should be excluded.

existingMods.notes: YAML edit and clone of creatures, including MonsterAI flee fields and factions. RRR successor. Open source.

ideas.inspiration: Vanilla MonsterAI already has flee settings that prefabs mostly leave unused (m_fleeIfLowHealth, m_fleeIfNotAlerted, m_fleeIfHurtWhenTargetCantBeReached, m_crownFearRange for the Crown of Valheim; BaseAI m_fleeRange and m_fleeAngle). Data editors only set these. Borrow Mark of Oden's progression-based threat model. Add behaviour: morale breaks, wide berth for weak creatures, and an unstick routine after root, freeze or stagger (nobody does this). The AI must run correctly on whichever client owns the zone. Valheim Community Patch fixes the related vanilla stuck-at-0-HP bug.

ideas.name: Breeding revamp
ideas.description: (from 50/50 from parent to lowest of parent + chance of proc +1)
ideas.sketch: A MakePregnant postfix finds the nearest ready partner (same prefab or m_seperatePartner) within m_partnerCheckRange and stores its level in a custom ZDO int on the pregnant parent. A Procreate prefix and postfix set and clear a thread-static birth context. Inside that context, Character.SetLevel and ItemDrop.SetQuality prefixes replace the level with max(minOffspring, min(own, partner)) + (Random < chance ? 1 : 0), clamped to a configurable cap (default 3).
ideas.risks: Pregnancies started before install have no stored partner (fall back to own level). Both parents can become pregnant in vanilla. The SetLevel patch must be strictly scoped to the context, or world spawns are affected. Conflicts with AllTameable-style breeding mods and star-level mods (levels above 3 show no stars in EnemyHud).

existingMods.notes: YAML file with a LevelUpChance and MaxStars per prefab (boar 25%, wolf 10%). Adds a chance of +1 on top of the vanilla base level, which is the birthing parent's.

existingMods.name: TameCraft (momos3939)

existingMods.name: CreatureGenetics / AllTameable Taming Overhaul (Meldurson)
existingMods.notes: Levels inherited from the parents with a +/-1 mutation. Eggs carry the level. DNA traits. Open source (github.com/meldurson).

ideas.inspiration: Nobody implements min(parents) + chance of +1. The +1 chance exists on its own, and two-parent inheritance only exists inside big overhauls. Vanilla Procreation.Procreate uses max(m_minOffspringLevel, birthing parent level) and never stores the partner. Plan: when ZDOVars.s_pregnant is set, record the nearest partner's level (within m_partnerCheckRange) in the mother's ZDO. At birth, roll min + chance of +1. Pass the result to eggs through ItemDrop quality (EggGrow reads it). Only the ZDO owner decides. The rule is configurable (min/avg/max/vanilla). The +1 chance could scale with skill or food so the min rule does not stall progress.

ideas.name: Ashlands trees
ideas.description: safe  if in shield, Crop burns out outside, tree changes to scorched tree outside
ideas.sketch: An AshExposure component is added at ZNetScene.Awake to every crop Pickable and TreeBase reachable from sapling m_grownPrefabs. On the owner it ticks every 10-20 s and accumulates exposure in a custom ZDO float while the object is in the Ashlands and outside every shield, after a grace period of at least 20 s from load. Past a threshold, a crop burns and is destroyed (optional Coal drop) and a tree is replaced by a configured scorched prefab (AshlandsTree1-6 or a stump). A Plant.UpdateHealth postfix destroys saplings that stay TooHot too long.
ideas.risks: IsInsideShield only sees loaded generators and uses the animated radius, which is 0 at load or when fuel is empty. Without grace and hysteresis, farms die on login. Losing a farm when fuel runs out is harsh: add hover warnings and config. Vanilla cinder fire already burns trees outside shields. Include PlantEverything-style saplings.

existingMods.name: PlantEverything (Advize), related
existingMods.notes: Its EnforceBiomes and related options relax planting restrictions, the opposite direction. We must stay compatible.

existingMods.name: ServersideQoL PrefabConfigurator (ArgusMagnus), related
existingMods.notes: Generic prefab tweaks such as plant grow time and space. No heat mechanic.

ideas.inspiration: A genuine gap. Vanilla Plant.UpdateHealth only blocks growth (Status.TooHot) in Ashlands outside ShieldGenerator.IsInsideShield for plants without m_tolerateHeat. Once Plant.Grow spawns the Pickable or TreeBase, nothing re-checks. Plan: a low-frequency, owner-only heat-exposure check on player-grown crops and trees, with a ZDO grace timer that gives a refuel window. Then swap to a burnt crop or a vanilla Ashlands dead-tree prefab. ZDO timestamps let unloaded zones catch up. This makes the Shield Generator the heart of Ashlands farms. Consider a cold mirror for Mountain and Deep North.

Tune the TrainingDummy_attack* items (range, damage) so the stationary dummy can hit monsters that come into range. Optionally set m_aiSkipTarget so monsters ignore dummies.

One faction rule plus a target-selection hook turns dummies into decoys or sparring partners that hit monsters. There is no prior art. Watch base-defence balance and XP farming exploits.

ideas.name: Increase base HP/Stamina with stats
ideas.description: (running jump etc)
ideas.sketch: Postfix the private Player.GetTotalFoodValue (out hp, stamina, eitr) to add capped bonuses from skill levels (Run, Jump, Swim, Blocking) or PlayerProfile stats (DistanceRun, Jumps). Optionally mirror the bonus into m_baseHP so GetBaseFoodHP and the HUD stay consistent. Max HP propagates through the player's own ZDO max_health.

If we do it, keep it a light, capped bonus from existing skills (Run, Jump, Swim) with no new skill, so it stays subordinate to food.

ideas.name: Better tower shields
ideas.description: Make them usable. I see them as a immovable wall that can't parry: The player should be slowed A LOT but should be able to block virtually anything > idea, make them TWO HANDED, very slow, with a small shield bash attack, and a lot of block armor
ideas.sketch: Pick tower shields from a configurable prefab list: ShieldWoodTower, ShieldBoneTower, ShieldIronTower, ShieldSerpentscale (the wiki lists the Serpent Scale Shield with the tower shields), ShieldBlackmetalTower, ShieldFlametalTower and ShieldGoldTower. FW_ShieldBlackmetalTower and SP_ShieldBlackmetalTower are separate prefabs (their prefixes match the FallenWarrior and ShadowPerson creature prefabs, unverified) and stay untouched. An ObjectDB.Awake/CopyOtherDB postfix edits their SharedData. (1) Set m_itemType to TwoHandedWeaponLeft and m_attachOverride to Shield. Vanilla Humanoid.EquipItem then empties both hands when the shield is equipped, and a one-handed weapon or torch replaces it. Humanoid.Pickup stops auto-equipping weapons. The back model and the armor stand slot follow m_attachOverride, so they stay those of a shield. The tooltip says two-handed and shows damage. (2) Keep m_timedBlockBonus at 1 or lower so it cannot parry (the wiki already lists no parry bonus for tower shields, so this guards against other mods), and set m_perfectBlockAdrenaline to 0, because the tooltip shows a parry-adrenaline line whenever it is above 0. (3) Multiply m_blockPower and m_blockPowerPerLevel (the block armor). In the vanilla block formula, block armor far above the hit's damage cuts the damage taken, the stamina per block, the stagger and the knockback. (4) Make m_movementModifier more negative, but keep it above -0.67. (5) Set m_attack to a clone of the player's unarmed combo (Humanoid.m_unarmedWeapon), which already plays in the shield stance. No player exists yet when ObjectDB loads, so take it from the player prefab (Game.m_playerPrefab) or clone it on first use, as CaptainValheim does at attack time. Give the shield blunt m_damages from block armor, a high m_attackForce and attack stagger multiplier, m_skillType Blocking, and m_blockable/m_dodgeable true. Humanoid.GetCurrentWeapon then returns the shield, so the normal attack button bashes through vanilla StartAttack, and GetCurrentBlocker still blocks with it. While blocking, an UpdateBlock postfix adds a local SE_Stats brace slow, which also slows walking, crouching and turning. An RPC_Damage prefix makes frontal hits blockable, filtered by HitType (fall hits use the ground normal as direction and pass the facing test). A Character.AddStaggerDamage prefix, scoped to BlockAttack, skips or scales the stagger while stamina remains, because a stagger ends IsBlocking and the next hits land unblocked. Rear hits and stamina stay the counterplay. Everything runs on the bearer's own client: equipping, attacks and movement run there, the bash's HitData is built by the attacker, and incoming hits are resolved by the victim's owner. So it is client-only.
ideas.risks: Changing m_itemType is global and breaks code that looks for ItemType.Shield. CaptainValheim's shield techniques check it (seen in its source). EpicLoot's shield enchant rules and auto-equip-shield features such as ZenCombat's probably do too (unverified). MC's own shared ItemKinds classifier (Sort Chest, Crafting Search and Sort) would file tower shields under weapons unless it also reads m_attachOverride. ItemStand.CanAttach matches its supported types against m_itemType, not m_attachOverride, so an item stand that lists Shield but not TwoHandedWeaponLeft would refuse tower shields (stand lists unverified). Fallback: keep ItemType.Shield, enforce two hands with Humanoid.EquipItem postfixes, and swap in the bash through a GetCurrentWeapon/StartAttack override, as CaptainValheim does. EquipItem enforces hands only at equip time, so turning the feature on while a sword and a tower shield are held must unequip the sword. Vanilla block charges fire the shield's own m_attack through Attack.StartWithoutAnimation. A mod that turns m_buildBlockCharges on (ZenCombat, CaptainValheim) would fire our bash as that counter. The equipment movement modifier only scales jog and run speed, run, jump and dodge stamina, and knockback. Walk and crouch speed ignore it, so with the code defaults (jog 10, walk 5) a modifier below -0.5 makes walking faster than jogging. The run factor reaches 0 at -0.67 and the jog factor at -1. Below that, Character.UpdateWalking gets a negative speed that nothing clamps unless an SE_Stats is active. The rest of the slow therefore needs an SE. An SE speed of -1 or lower roots the player and turns jumps into weak tired jumps. Some damage breaks the block or never reaches BlockAttack. Hits with m_staggerMultiplier of 100 or more stagger before the block check. Aoe.m_blockable is false in code by default, and fire (CinderFire) hits are unblockable. AoE launches (ForceJump) and Aoe.m_knockBackForce pushes are applied in Aoe.OnHit, which a networked AoE runs on its owner's machine, so the bearer's client may not be the one applying them. DoTs, lava and falls skip blocking. Stagger is counted twice: BlockAttack adds it from the damage left after block armor, and ApplyDamage adds it again from what lands, times m_staggerMultiplier. Shield base values, block-charge settings and the vanilla slow are prefab data (unverified): the wiki says -10% for tower shields, Make Tower Shields Great Again's page says -20%. CaptainValheim (BlockAttack transpiler, GetCurrentWeapon, StartAttack, Pickup, RPC_Damage), ReliableBlock (BlockAttack transpiler), GCO and ZenCombat (closed source) and EpicLoot (GetBlockPower, unverified) touch the same code. The MC mods Crossbow Stays Loaded (BlockAttack postfix, UnequipItem prefix, GetTooltip postfix) and Harpoon Hooks Tames (RPC_Damage prefix and postfix) need cross tests. Huge block armor plus a bash is a PvP balance issue, so ship a server-synced config. RPC_Damage is hot and long, so patch it with a prefix only.

existingMods.notes: Turns shields into weapons. With an empty right hand, the primary attack is a shield strike built from a clone of the vanilla unarmed attack. Its damage comes from block power (x0.4 by default) and its push from deflection force (x0.4 by default), and it scales with the Blocking skill. Also adds a shield throw, a charge (block + secondary attack), projectile reflection and the vanilla block-charge counter. Applies to every shield through a global fallback, keeps tower shields one-handed, and its techniques check ItemType.Shield. Patches Humanoid.GetCurrentWeapon, StartAttack, Pickup, BlockAttack (transpiler) and Character.RPC_Damage, among others. Source: github.com/sighsorry1029/CaptainValheim (GPL-3.0 and MIT license files). Tagged AI Generated. About 2.4K downloads.

Blunt damage scales with block power and the Blocking skill, plus enemy knockback and a dynamic stamina cost. The page does not say which shields it works with. Needs Jotunn (2.29.1). About 6.4K downloads.

existingMods.status: v1.0.2, updated 2026-09-25, tagged Deep North (1.0: yes)

Reliable block: block defence still applies while a hit staggers you, as long as you have stamina. Also scales knockback (block deflection 0%, melee 40%, area and ranged 50% by default) and auto-equips your last shield when you draw a one-handed weapon. Closed source (the GitHub repo only holds the wiki, the issue tracker and modpack files). About 97K downloads.

Heavy hits still stagger you and deal a lot of damage. Done with a Humanoid.BlockAttack transpiler. Required by Make Tower Shields Great Again. Source: github.com/karkkant/valheim-reliable_block. About 140K downloads.

existingMods.name: GrindstoneSkills (MilkyTeam)
existingMods.notes: Blocking-skill perks: up to a 15% chance that a normal block staggers the attacker, up to 25% more poise, and a Shield Wall perk from level 50 (players within 4 m behind a blocking player take 10% less damage). Must be installed on the server and every client. Source: github.com/geraldjglasgow/ValheimMods. About 530 downloads.

existingMods.name: Combat Adjustments (NickSpinosa)
existingMods.status: v0.1.0 per its design doc, source only, last commit 2026-09-28, checked against Valheim 1.0.7 (1.0: yes)
existingMods.notes: Hold-block rework. Shields add a flat amount to the stagger bar while equipped (Flametal tower +70 at max quality; round shields and bucklers less). Tower shields also get +5% block armor, and towers and round shields +20% durability. The goal is that hold-blocking stays viable while big hits still break the block. No slow, parry or two-handed change. Server-authoritative and needs the author's MushroomSync plugin. No Thunderstore page found.

existingMods.name: Valheim Combat Overhaul (Kyresel)
existingMods.notes: Tower shields trade their parry for blocking damage beyond their block power at extra stamina cost. Surplus damage drains stamina instead of health, and no hit staggers you while stamina remains after the block. 40% less block stamina than other shields, halved knockback on a successful block, and 'stickiness' to the opponent. Nexus mod 591.

ideas.inspiration: Vanilla already provides most of the parts: the TwoHandedWeaponLeft equip rules, the unarmed combo (it already plays while a shield is held), a block formula where very high block armor absorbs almost everything (less damage, stamina, stagger and push per hit), and a block-charge counter that is switched off. Borrow four things. From GCO: 'hold until stamina is empty, no stagger or knockback'. From ReliableBlock and ZenCombat: the block still counts when a hit staggers you (ours goes further and prevents that stagger while stamina lasts). From CaptainValheim: the empty-hand strike built from the cloned unarmed attack, with damage from block power, push from deflection force and Blocking skill scaling. From Make Tower Shields Great Again: knockback on block. What they get wrong: GCO locks the stance inside a huge overhaul. CaptainValheim gives every shield a strike and ShieldBash adds a bash on an extra key, but neither makes tower shields two-handed, so you still carry a sword. Make Tower Shields Great Again only changes numbers and depends on mods from before 1.0. Combat Adjustments only enlarges the stagger bar. Ours gives tower shields their own identity. They are two-handed under the vanilla rules and very slow when carried, slower still while bracing. They get much more block armor, no parry, and a frontal block that also stops AoE and projectiles. The bash is small and cheap and uses the normal attack button. Detect GCO, ZenCombat, CaptainValheim and ShieldBash and warn.

ideas.name: Crossbow revamp
ideas.description: Stays loaded
ideas.sketch: Keep a per-item flag in ItemData.m_customData (e.g. 'VM.CrossbowLoaded'), which is persisted in inventories, chests, drops and saves and ignored by vanilla. A postfix on the private Player.SetWeaponLoaded sets the flag when the weapon is non-null. A postfix on Attack.OnAttackTrigger clears it only when the shot actually fired, i.e. the character is no longer loaded. A prefix on the private Player.UpdateWeaponLoading instantly calls SetWeaponLoaded(weapon) and skips the reload queue when the newly equipped crossbow is flagged. Vanilla unequip paths keep nulling m_weaponLoaded harmlessly, and the ZDO WeaponLoaded bool keeps visuals correct for all players.
ideas.risks: Pre-loading several crossbows enables instant swap volleys, so add a config option to remember only the last loaded one. Ammo is consumed at fire time, so there is no ammo dupe. The target methods are private (AccessTools or a publicized assembly) and may be renamed by game patches. Any m_requiresReload weapon from content mods is affected, which is generic and intended.

ideas.inspiration: Vanilla: Player keeps the loaded weapon as an ItemData reference (m_weaponLoaded), mirrored to the ZDO (ZDOVars.s_weaponLoaded) through Player.SetWeaponLoaded. Humanoid.UnequipItem calls ResetLoadedWeapon for any weapon. Player.UpdateWeaponLoading queues a reload whenever the equipped weapon is not the loaded one (with eitr drain for Dundr through m_reloadEitrDrain). Ours: a per-item persisted flag (for example ItemData.m_customData) restored on equip, covering every m_requiresReload weapon (crossbows, Dundr, modded), with a clear rule for drop and trade and optional persistence across logout. The gap is simply a maintained, 1.0-verified version.

While active, the map unlocks an extended pin palette (icons, colors, notes), Pinnacle-style search, team or public pins (Better Cartography Table's per-pin visibility stored on the table ZDO), and ZenMap-style live-tracked assets. Keep the vanilla map everywhere else and mirror our data into vanilla shared pins (MapTable.OnWrite and Minimap.GetSharedMapData). ideas.name: Forge of potential revamp
ideas.description: Only consumes the idol on failure, does not destroy the item. Need higher tier idol when high level enough. Might require skill level to be able to craft, Upgrade idols with trophies to inrease odds (low trophy brings it up to 50%, elite to 70, zone boss 95)
ideas.sketch: A prefix on InventoryGui.DoCrafting takes over the Forge branch (station.m_upgrader). It rolls our own chance for the idol actually spent: a configurable base for a plain idol, or 50%, 70% or 95% for an idol infused with a common, elite or zone-boss trophy (the trophy sets the chance, it does not add to it). On success it raises m_quality in place, which keeps the crafter, world level and m_customData. Durability must be set on purpose: a higher quality has a higher max durability, and vanilla re-creates the item at full durability. Keep vanilla's unequip so hand, back and shoulder visuals refresh. On failure it removes only that idol (Inventory.RemoveItem by name and quality) and leaves the item untouched. The infusion is stored as the idol's own m_quality (1 plain, 2 common, 3 elite, 4 boss). This vanilla field is saved everywhere, and Inventory.FindFreeStackItem already stacks only equal qualities. Raising the idols' SharedData.m_maxQuality to 4 in ObjectDB.Awake/CopyOtherDB also keeps levels apart on drag and drop (ItemData.IsSameType, InventoryGrid.DropItem) and shows the level on the slot. Infusing happens in the Upgrade tab of a normal station: one recipe per idol prefab with m_noCraftOnlyUpgrade and m_requireOnlyOneIngredient, whose trophy requirements are banded per step by a Piece.Requirement.GetAmount postfix. Our own DoCrafting branch runs these recipes, because the vanilla upgrade path removes the whole idol stack and gives back one item. Trophy classes are built at ZNetScene.Awake: boss = trophies in the CharacterDrop of prefabs with Character.m_boss; elite = a config list; common = every other trophy. The Deep North boss (Kall Fimbulbringer) has no trophy, so the Bloodgold boss step needs a configured item such as Sacrificial Blood (FrozenKingDrop). A biome-tier gate stops a cheap trophy from lifting a high-tier idol. Keep the higher-tier idol bands at high levels and the Crafting skill gate in UpdateRecipe and DoCrafting.
ideas.risks: The sheet's ladder only makes sense if a plain idol rolls below 50%, which is lower than vanilla's 65%. That is fair only because a failure no longer costs the item, so make it configurable and flag it. What a vanilla failure does is disputed (the wiki and Forge No Destroy: the item is always destroyed; OdinBet and Forge of Certainty: usually a level is lost), so dump the idol prefabs. Without a biome gate, a Boar trophy or a re-summoned Eikthyr would lift a Bloodgold idol. 'Elite' has no vanilla flag, so it needs a config list. The vanilla only-one-ingredient helpers mishandle a 0-amount requirement: Player.HaveRequirementItems returns true, and Player.GetFirstRequiredItem returns a null item that Recipe.GetAmount dereferences in both OnCraftPressed and DoCrafting. Recipe.GetRequiredStationLevel (max(1, m_minStationLevel) + q - 1) needs a level-4 station for the boss step. Raising the idols' m_maxQuality also puts other mods' idol recipes (ReforgedPotential, OdinBet, JGFoP, DowngradeableIdols) in their station's Upgrade tab, where the vanilla upgrade path eats the whole stack. Where idols keep m_maxQuality 1 (vanilla players, or after an uninstall), the vanilla Forge counts only quality-1 idols, so infused idols are refused until they are dragged onto a plain stack, and plain idols dragged onto an infused stack become infused. ReforgedPotential reports greyed-out icons with dynamic requirements. Many Forge mods patch DoCrafting or the idol data (EpicLoot, ReforgedPotential, OdinBet, JGFoP, Wire's, the IL patch in ForgeOfPotentialSafe, Potential Forge NoFail, Potential Draught, Forge No Destroy, G3A3), so keep the prefix narrow and declare them incompatible. Our framework has no config sync yet. Fix the vanilla $msg_upgrader_failed key.

existingMods.name: G3A3 (G3A1)
existingMods.notes: All-in-one pack. Its ForgeOfPotential section changes the upgrade odds, and its difficulty sections (BossIdols, Idols) hand out Forge of Potential idols as a reward. Server-synced; the server and every player need the same version. One more mod that touches the Forge odds.

ideas.inspiration: Vanilla already spends only the idol at the Forge: Player.ConsumeResources skips non-upgrader requirements there. What a failure really costs is the item, but sources disagree on how. The wiki and Forge No Destroy say every vanilla 1.0 failure destroys it (65% success, 35% destroyed with 35% of the materials back, which needs idol prefabs with m_breakChance of at least 0.35). OdinBet's readme says a normal failure loses a level, and Forge of Certainty quotes 65/25/10, which is what the code defaults give. A data dump settles it. Most mods remove the gamble (ForgeOfPotentialSafe, Odin's Blessing, Potential Forge NoFail, Forge of Certainty, and ReforgedPotential and OdinBet at their 100% defaults) or soften it (Forge No Destroy downgrades instead of destroying; Wire's loses no level up to +5; OdinBet with LevelsLostOnFailure 0 and Forge of Progression with the None penalty keep the item's level, which already covers our first part as a setting). Odds boosters exist, but not per idol: Forge of Progression spends trophies to upgrade the station, and Potential Draught is a timed potion. OdinBet and JGFoP use boss trophies (and Sacrificial Blood for Bloodgold) only as idol ingredients, and nobody infuses idols with trophies. Ours: a failure loses only the idol, a plain idol has a low base chance, and trophies set 50/70/95%. The infusion is stored as idol quality, so there are no new prefabs and the mod stays client-only; after an uninstall, infused idols must be merged onto a plain stack before the vanilla Forge accepts them. Trophies are biome-gated, higher-tier idols are required at high levels, the Crafting skill gate is optional and the chance is shown on the button. Borrow Wire's live odds display, ReforgedPotential's idol-threshold progression and Forge of Progression's biome-tier trophy costs.

ideas.name: Unlock biome feast in the biome not after

ideas.name: Loot filter
ideas.sketch: A small transpiler on Player.AutoPickup replaces the m_autoPickup field check with LootFilter.Allow(drop), which returns drop.m_autoPickup && !blocked(prefabName/itemType). Items are toggled with Alt+right-click in the inventory and marked with a tinted overlay. The list is stored per character in Player.m_customData['vm.lootfilter'] with a BepInEx default list. An optional three-state V toggle cycles Off / All / Filtered.
ideas.risks: Transpiler collisions with other AutoPickup patchers (pickup-range and pickup-selector mods, ValheimPlus remnants). Never overwrite m_autoPickup, because it also encodes 'dropped by me'. Token name collisions between modded items, so key on the prefab name. No save or network risk.

ideas.name: Sort chest
ideas.sketch: A Sort button is cloned from Stack All. On click, only when the local client is owner and no drag is active, merge partial stacks of IsSameType items with identical m_customData (OR the m_cheated flags). Order by type group, localized name, quality and stack, reassign m_gridPos row-major, and call Inventory.Changed once so Container.Save writes ZDO s_items. Auto-sort on close and locked slots are optional.
ideas.risks: IsSameType ignores m_customData (EpicLoot and similar mods), so the merge must compare custom data explicitly. Do not rebuild with AddItem, which works per unit and fires Changed per call. UI reskins and other sort mods (Quick Stack-Store-Sort-Trash, AzuAutoStore) occupy the same button area.

Only worth building as part of a unified storage-UX module (sort, search, filter and loot rules on one category and favourites model). Player sort touches only rows 1..H-1 and optionally keeps equipped items fixed, filling materials bottom-up like vanilla TopFirst. It reuses the shared merge and sort routine from Sort chest, with a button and a hotkey gated on InventoryGui.IsVisible.
ideas.risks: The gamepad radial lists items in grid order, so sorting reshuffles it. Mods that park equipment in extra inventory rows need those rows excluded (rows beyond 'invrows'). Same custom-data merge caveat as Sort chest.

Otherwise this is the same module as Sort chest applied to the player grid, with the hotbar locked and favourites respected.

ideas.name: Sleep through the day
ideas.sketch: Client: postfix EnvMan.CalculateCanSleep to allow mornings (keep cooldown) and write a sleep-mode ZDO key on the player before AttachStart. Server: Game.UpdateSleeping prefix that, when everyone is in bed in the morning, sets EnvMan private m_skipTime/m_skipToTime (day*m_dayLengthSec + configurable raw fraction ~0.80)/m_timeSkipSpeed (delta/12), sets Game.m_sleeping and sends SleepStart; vanilla stop branch finishes; patch wake message.
ideas.risks: Extra time skips accelerate crops/smelters/fermenters (balance); Rested granted each wake; must use live m_dayLengthSec (day-length mods like ValheimPlus); unmodded clients cannot lie down in the morning so no forced skips.

existingMods.name: BedRules (TastyChickenLegs)
existingMods.notes: Sleep anytime; ignore fire, enemies and wet; no spawn or claim needed. Time target not documented; presumably still skips to the next morning.

existingMods.name: Sleepover (Azumatt)
existingMods.notes: 'Sleep at any time of day (may be buggy)', multiple sleepers per bed, every check toggleable. Needs the mod on all clients and the server.

existingMods.name: Sleep Options (Nexus 2716)
existingMods.notes: Toggles the night, enemy, exposure, fire and wet checks.

existingMods.name: SleepSkip (Azumatt) / SkipSleep / NowYouSleep
existingMods.notes: Partial-player or vote-based night skipping. None handles day sleep.

ideas.inspiration: Vanilla Game.UpdateSleeping only allows sleep when EnvMan.IsAfternoon or IsNight, and EnvMan.SkipToMorning always targets the next morning (12 s skip in EnvMan.UpdateTimeSkip). No mod offers 'rest until dusk'. Add a second bed option, 'Rest until evening', that reuses the vanilla skip but targets the same day's evening. Keep the everyone-agrees rule (optional vote ratio), Rested, and the enemy/wet safety checks. Server-side patch plus an RPC; clients only need the mod for hover text. Avoid Sleepover's check-bypassing approach.

ideas.name: Search chest
ideas.sketch: Clone the 1.0 build-menu search field into the container and player panel headers and normalize the term like BuildUi.UpdateSearch. An InventoryGrid.UpdateGui postfix greys out non-matching slots each frame; nothing is written, so there is no network impact. It matches cached localized name, token, prefab and type, and supports t:/@ prefixes. v2 scans cached nearby Container instances (read-only, respecting ward and privacy) and highlights chests that contain matches.
ideas.risks: Typed keys leak into game hotkeys: Tab, E and Esc close the inventory, and console binds fire. The Chat.HasFocus postfix plus a guard on binds fixes this; gamepad needs testing. Per-frame cost requires a cached localized-name dictionary. Other mods reuse the same template or relayout the panel. Nearby search must not leak warded or private chest contents.

ideas.inspiration: The user assumed nothing existed, but a wave of mods appeared after 1.0. Two features: filter the open grid (dim or highlight rather than hide, to keep spatial memory) and find across nearby containers (only loaded zones have live inventories, so searching further needs remembered contents). Vanilla 1.0 now has a native search field in the build menu (BuildUi GuiInputField, BuildUi.UpdateSearch with localized terms). Copy that look and controller behaviour so ours feels built-in.

ideas.name: Search crafting station
ideas.sketch: Add a search field above m_recipeListRoot. MVP: write the terms into Player.s_FilterCraft and call UpdateCraftingPanel(false); Clear() it when the field is empty, because a [''] filter hides everything. Better: a GetAvailableRecipes postfix with AND matching, ingredient names and a 'craftable only' toggle, active only during our refresh. Add a sort dropdown bound to the vanilla 'sortcraft' key and clear the filter on Hide.
ideas.risks: s_FilterCraft is static and shared with the console, so a stale filter survives. GetAvailableRecipes is also called by other mods (recipe browsers, EpicLoot UIs), so the filter must be scoped with a flag. Crafting-panel reskins and craft-from-containers mods may relayout the panel.

ideas.inspiration: Vanilla 1.0 gave the build menu a search field (BuildUi.UpdateSearch) but not the InventoryGui crafting list, so a clone of the native build search is the most natural option. Borrow ingredient search ('!'), a 'craftable now' toggle and category chips. Share one search component across crafting, containers and build.

ideas.name: Harpoon to work on tamed animals
ideas.sketch: A Projectile.IsValidTarget postfix returns true for a tamed target when the owner is the local player and the projectile's status effect resolves to SE_Harpooned. A Character.Damage prefix on the attacker side zeroes damage, push force and stagger for that hit. ApplyDamage then exits early (no damage, no alert), while RPC_Damage still applies the SE on the tame's owner.
ideas.risks: PvP players can already harpoon tames but also damage them; apply the zero-damage rule anyway. Heavy tames drain a lot of stamina (scaled by mass). There is no pull while the tame is on a ship and no upward force. Keep the patch additive to coexist with EpicLoot projectile patches.

ideas.inspiration: Covered as of yesterday by a brand-new AI-tagged 1.0.0. Build our own only as part of a Ranching bundle. Possible additions: owner-only or ward-only hooking, a soft 'leash' mode with no line break, and a lead-to-pen command. Vanilla filters tames in the Attack/Projectile hit logic (IsTamed, SharedData.m_tamedOnly).

Only worth it inside a Crafting QoL bundle.

ideas.name: Torches ON/OFF only, no fuel
ideas.sketch: For whitelisted Fireplace prefabs (torches, sconces, braziers), set m_infiniteFuel=true, m_canTurnOff=true and m_canRefill=false at ZNetScene.Awake. A prefix on Interact allows toggling at 0 fuel, and a postfix on GetHoverText adds on/off text. Toggling uses the vanilla s_state; also top up s_fuel so pieces stay lit for a while after uninstall.
ideas.risks: A vanilla ZDO owner still burns fuel and vanilla viewers see torches go out. Pieces with wet Low/High visuals auto-turn off in rain once m_canTurnOff is true. Overlaps with V+ and other infinite-torch mods. Some 1.0 pieces already use these flags (runtime dump needed).

ideas.inspiration: Mostly prefab data. Vanilla Fireplace already has m_infiniteFuel, m_canTurnOff and m_canRefill, plus an on/off state in ZDOVars.s_state that Fireplace.Interact toggles. Our angle is the exact 'light switch' UX: light once to install it, then E toggles with no fuel. Cooking fires and bonfires optionally keep fuel so wood still matters. Bonus: a light group toggled from a switch piece or a ward, which ties into the ward revamp.

ideas.name: notifications stay longer and show multiple
ideas.sketch: Replace vanilla's single top-left line (one message per second, 4 s fade, merges only consecutive duplicates) with a pooled stack of N rows cloned from m_messageText and m_messageIcon, each with a configurable lifetime. Rows with the same key aggregate as xN and refresh their timer. Center messages get a small queue with a minimum display time instead of being overwritten. Unlock toasts get more slots and a slower animator. Pickups can optionally be logged into the 50-entry history.
ideas.risks: Other mods that prefix ShowMessage or read MessageHud internals. Skipping UpdateMessage entirely would break the center fade, so only reroute inside ShowMessage. More unlock slots at 110 px spacing can run off-screen at high UI scale. The feed must honour user-hidden HUD and showDespiteHiddenHUD.

existingMods.name: NotificationsOverhaul (blacks7ar)
existingMods.notes: Configurable duration, max visible, position, font and colour; pickup-only or global. About 12K downloads.

existingMods.name: BetterPickupNotifications (Pfhoenix)
existingMods.notes: Reworked pickup message handling.

existingMods.notes: Timed stacked notification layer. Open source.

existingMods.name: NotificationTweaks (digitiliad)
existingMods.notes: Count shown at once, fade, merging of similar messages.

ideas.inspiration: Vanilla MessageHud shows top-left messages one at a time from a queue on a short timer, merging identical consecutive messages (MessageHud.UpdateMessage). Unlock messages have their own queue, and there is a 50-entry m_messageLog. Ours: a stacked N-line feed, per-item merged counts ('Wood x37'), longer display for important messages than for pickups, and an optional history panel from the existing log. Small and low-risk, and nothing maintained is confirmed on 1.0.

ideas.name: Place sign on chest
ideas.sketch: A transpiler (or re-validating postfix) in UpdatePlacementGhost skips the m_supports rejection when the ghost has a Sign and the hit piece has a Container. A transpiler in UpdateSupport lets Sign pieces use Container neighbours as support (instead of setting chest m_supports globally, which would allow stacking). Optionally add snappoint children on chest faces. Alternative: a 'chest label' via alt-interact, stored in a custom ZDO string and rendered as a TMP label.
ideas.risks: A vanilla owner computes zero support and breaks the sign. Transpiler conflicts with build mods (Gizmo, PlanBuild, build cameras). On uninstall, signs on chests collapse. Removing the chest drops the sign.

existingMods.name: Chest Labels (Nexus 3629)
existingMods.notes: Ctrl+E opens the vanilla sign text panel. The label renders as 3D text on 4 sides, auto-sized per chest type, and is stored in the world save.

existingMods.notes: The server auto-attaches vanilla signs to chests and barrels, optionally with a content list. The signs also configure the other SQoL modules.

existingMods.name: RunicStorage (Chazman)
existingMods.notes: Colored labels on chest faces and lids, plus a large storage suite.

existingMods.name: ZenSign (ZenDragon)
existingMods.notes: A sign shows an item icon and the total in nearby chests. Tap it to highlight those chests.

ideas.inspiration: Labeling is covered. The building QoL of placing an ordinary sign flush on a chest or barrel face is not. Plan: a placement tweak that, when the sign ghost's ray hits a Container collider, snaps the sign to that face (normal, center, offset). The sign stays an independent piece, so it is safe for multiplayer and uninstall. Later: Chest Labels-style auto-sized text and ZenSign-style item icons. Test round barrels and all chest sizes.

ideas.name: Shift + E to feed 5 items to furnaces and kilns
ideas.sketch: A prefix on Switch.Interact detects alt (AltPlace = Shift) on a Smelter's add-ore or add-fuel switch. Compute n = min(5, m_maxOre - GetQueueSize(), inventory count of the FindCookableItem type) (fuel: m_maxFuel - ceil(GetFuel())), then n times remove 1 item and InvokeRPC RPC_AddOre / RPC_AddFuel. Show one summary message and add a hover hint.
ideas.risks: Non-owners read a stale queue/fuel count and the owner handlers don't cap, so simultaneous feeding can overfill (a vanilla race too); track recently sent counts. Low conflict with auto-fuel and V+ since limits are read live.

existingMods.notes: Shift adds a stack or fills to the limit. One unified interaction patch covers smelters, kilns, fireplaces, cooking stations and shield generators. Clean open source.

existingMods.notes: Stations pull fuel and ore from nearby containers automatically.

existingMods.name: Add All Fuel And Ore (rin_jugatla)
existingMods.notes: The original. Can pull from containers.

ideas.inspiration: The difference is a deliberate fixed batch (N=5, configurable) rather than 'fill all', which keeps the pacing. Vanilla Smelter.OnAddOre / OnAddFuel add one item and send one RPC. Call that path N times, clamped by capacity and inventory, so it works on vanilla servers. Cover smelter, kiln, blast furnace, eitr refinery, windmill, spinning wheel and shield generator. Show feedback like '+5 (12/20)'.

ideas.name: Per creature kill count
ideas.sketch: Read m_playerStats[0].m_enemyStats[0][Character.m_name] (and modifier buckets) and show it on the enemy nameplate, in the trophy panel (map trophy prefab -> Character.m_name by scanning ZNetScene prefabs with CharacterDrop) and in the stats/compendium page. Data already exists and is retroactive.
ideas.risks: Counts are per character across worlds; key is the localization token shared by variants; PvP victims mixed in (filter non-'$' keys); read index 0 not achievement buckets; minor conflicts with nameplate UI mods.

existingMods.notes: Trophy tray HUD; tooltips show player kill counts, trophy pickups and drop rates. Built for speedrun modes.

ideas.inspiration: Key finding: vanilla already stores per-creature kills in PlayerProfile.m_playerStats[i].m_enemyStats[KillModifiers] (keyed by creature name, split total/unarmed/magic/ranged/melee, incremented by PlayerProfile.IncrementStatEnemy, saved in the .fch profile). Achievements use it, but the Compendium stats page (TextsDialog.AddStats) only prints category headers. Build a tiny mod that reads these vanilla stats (no own tracking, no save risk) and shows them in trophy tooltips, the creature hover/nameplate and the Compendium. Kill milestones can then unlock bestiary knowledge tiers (Compendium idea).

ideas.name: Ping system revamp
ideas.sketch: Add an in-world ping key that raycasts from GameCamera (about 250 m) and classifies the hit: enemy, loot, resource, structure or 'go here'; double-tap marks danger. It sends a rate-limited routed RPC 'VM_Ping' (ZPackage with type, true position, optional ZDOID and label) to everyone, plus the vanilla Chat.SendPing for unmodded peers. Modded receivers suppress the duplicate vanilla ping in an AddInworldText prefix. Receivers render pooled world markers cloned from Chat.m_worldTextBase with ObjectDB or pin icons and distance, an edge arrow, typed minimap pins via AddPin(save:false), several pings per player and a configurable TTL. Gamepad users get a radial ping wheel.
ideas.risks: Spam and griefing, so rate-limit both sending and receiving. A custom RPC bypasses platform block-list checks unless RelationsManager is reused. Vanilla hides pings beyond 50 m in no-map worlds, so the mod should respect that for fairness. Key conflicts (middle mouse is secondary attack and remove) and a lack of free gamepad buttons. World-space UI cost, so pool the markers. Conflicts with other waypoint or ping mods patching the same Chat or Minimap methods. Only clients with the mod see rich pings; the server needs nothing.

ideas.description: Bring new challenges and rewards for resummoning bosses
ideas.sketch: Track per-world kills per boss in a valued global key; on summon the altar owner (prefix on DelayedSpawnBoss sets a static spawn context) stamps a tier into the boss ZDO right after Instantiate. Every peer applies the tier from the ZDO in Character.Awake (HP/damage multipliers, resistances, a tier-specific m_bossEvent RandomEvent that spawns adds/changes weather) and the boss owner appends tier rewards in GenerateDropList.
ideas.risks: SetLevel also multiplies level-multiplied drops by 2^(level-1); conflicts with CLLC boss affixes, Drop That/Spawn That, EpicLoot (level-keyed loot tables, death/drop patches); keep activeBosses/NoBossPortals bookkeeping; world-level summon items; ownership migration mid-fight (store state in ZDO, apply idempotently).

existingMods.notes: Boss modifiers (BossSummoner, SoulEater, LifeLink, ResistPierce, Brutal), stars above 2, YAML loot scaling, public API.

existingMods.notes: The classic: boss affixes (Reflective, Shielded, Mending, Summoner, Elementalist, Enraged, Twin), boss level range, loot multipliers.

Each tier raises the offering cost, adds stars and affixes (reuse our mob variants), adds arena modifiers (forced weather, adds), and gives tier-specific rewards (trinket or Forsaken-power upgrades, crafting materials, cosmetics). Borrow Enhanced Bosses' JSON phases and ValheimFortress's reward flow. Integrate with the StarLevelSystem API instead of competing. Avoid global difficulty scalers.

ideas.name: Sailing revamp
ideas.description: Skill (easier to catch the wind, turn, stop, accelerate, wider map reveal radius)
ideas.sketch: Register a Sailing skill (Jotunn SkillManager or own injector) and grant XP to the helmsman while sailing with sail up. On taking the helm write the helmsman skill factor to the ship ZDO (and optionally make the helmsman owner); the owner's Ship.CustomFixedUpdate prefix scales m_sailForceFactor/m_stearForce/m_stearVelForceFactor/m_backwardForce and restores them in the postfix, GetWindAngleFactor/GetSailForce patches widen usable wind angles and speed up acceleration, an instant-stop key calls the unused Ship.Stop, and Minimap m_exploreRadius grows with skill while aboard.
ideas.risks: Physics runs on the ship ZDO owner (possibly a passenger) so mixed installs desync; must restore scaled fields (finalizer) to avoid compounding; conflicts with ValheimRAFT, sail/wind mods and the linked Nexus mod 922; custom skill data dropped from saves if mod removed; do not alter EnvMan wind globally.

Handling is tuned by Ship.m_sailForceFactor, m_rudderSpeed, m_stearForce and m_backwardForce, used in Ship.GetSailForce and UpdateSail. Build a real Sailing skill, gained at the helm, covering the user's list: a wider angle where the sail still pulls (not wind cheating, so tacking keeps skill), turn rate, braking/reverse, acceleration, a larger explore radius, and milestone abilities (lookout, wind forecast). Apply the controlling player's skill (Player.GetControlledShip). Avoid 'always tailwind' cheats and bonuses only for ships you built. Check for conflicts with ImpactfulSkills and GrindstoneSkills.

ideas.description: One very large unique dungeon per biome with end game level of difficulty
ideas.sketch: One location prefab per biome with a DungeonGenerator using a custom Room.Theme bit (e.g. 0x8000) and larger m_zoneSize, registered unique+prioritized so world gen places exactly one; revealed by a vegvisir/NPC. For existing worlds a server pass spawns it in an ungenerated/empty zone via the private SpawnLocation and registers it as placed.
ideas.risks: Room geometry is parented to the generator and vanishes when the generator's zone leaves the player's near simulation ring (1 zone at lowest setting) - chain zone-sized generators via Teleport pairs for very large dungeons; interior EnvZone only 64x500x64; one location per zone and only ungenerated zones; orphan ZDOs/'Missing room' if mod removed; clashes with location packs and world-gen mods (Warpalicious, Expand World, Better Continents); render/light cost.
