systems.summary: StatusEffect is a ScriptableObject with virtual Modify* hooks, which SEMan fans out for speed, damage, regen, stamina uses, adrenaline, stagger, stealth, noise and skills. SEs exist only on the character owner: the list is not replicated, only the seAttrib bitmask is. AddStatusEffect(hash) on a non-owner sends an RPC, and the owner looks the hash up in ObjectDB, so custom SEs applied by hash must be registered on every client. A speed modifier of -1 or less acts as a root (Immobilized* assets). SetLevel(itemLevel, skillLevel) scales hit-applied SEs.

systems.name: Monster AI & bosses
systems.summary: AI runs at 20 Hz on the monster's ZDO owner, usually the nearest client. MonsterAI.UpdateAI: sleep, UpdateTarget (every 2 or 6 s, FindEnemy, static targets), then ordered flee checks (crown, not alerted, low HP, lava, fire, no-monster areas, unreachable-while-hurt), consume items, circling, EquipBestWeapon, and move/attack with intercept prediction. When no path is found, MoveTo stops and reports arrived. Only flying AI has stuck detection; BaseAI.StandStillDuration is never used. BaseAI.IsEnemy holds the faction table and is a hot path. Bosses use m_boss, m_defeatSetGlobalKey and the activeBosses global key, and are summoned via the OfferingBowl RPCs.

systems.name: Turrets (ballista)
systems.summary: The owner runs UpdateTarget, which picks the closest sensed creature every 1 s (or 10 s when nothing is near) via FindClosestCreature (view distance, horizontal angle, target flags, trophy-configured names) and broadcasts RPC_SetTarget. Aiming uses a velocity lead with no gravity compensation. It fires when the aim dot is at least 0.9 and the cooldown (ZDO lastAttack) has passed. Bolts are set up with a null owner, so Projectile.IsValidTarget skips friend/foe checks and bolts can hit players and tames. Ammo lives in ZDO ammo/ammoType, and trophy targets in targets/target{i}.

systems.name: Training dummies & archery targets
systems.summary: The TrainingDummy faction is an enemy only of Players in BaseAI.IsEnemy. The dummy has attack items (TrainingDummy_attack, attack2, attack3, throw), so it is a Humanoid with MonsterAI that fights players. It exists as piece_TrainingDummy plus a character prefab. When a Character that is also a Piece dies, it refunds resources through Character.ApplyDamage. ArcheryTarget (IHitProjectile) scores hits, stores scores in the ZDO and gives accuracy-scaled skill XP. Character.SetDPSDebug gives a built-in DPS readout.

systems.name: Summons
systems.summary: A SpawnAbility projectile from a staff spawns creatures. m_maxSpawned uses SpawnSystem.GetNrOfInstances, which counts every loaded instance including other players' summons. m_copySkill writes RandomSkillFactor to the ZDO, and levelUpSettings writes level and maxInstances. m_commandOnSpawn makes the summon follow its owner (ZDO follow = player name), and Tameable.UnsummonMaxInstances keeps the newest N. Summons unsummon beyond m_unsummonDistance or after the owner has been logged out for a while, and tamed summons raise the owner's skill. Vanilla summons: Skeleton_Friendly, Troll_Summoned, Charred_Twitcher_Summoned, GreenRoots.

systems.name: Magic staffs (elemental & blood)
systems.summary: Staffs are ordinary weapons that use Attack eitr, health, burst, looping and missing-HP fields. Their payloads are Projectile, Aoe or SpawnAbility prefabs. Buffs and heals use a zero-damage friendly Aoe with m_statusEffect, applied through Character.RPC_Damage with item and skill level so SetLevel scales them. Vanilla includes StaffHeal (heal AoE), StaffShield (Staff_shield SE_Shield), StaffBlocker (barrier shapes), plus fire, ice, lightning, nova, frost orbs and summon staffs.

systems.name: Player vitals (HP / stamina / eitr)
systems.summary: Max HP = m_baseHP (25) plus foods, max stamina = m_baseStamina (75) plus foods, max eitr = foods only. Each food contributes value x (time/burn)^0.3. Player.UpdateFood recalculates every second through the private GetTotalFoodValue and SetMaxHealth (ZDO max_health), so bonuses must be injected there or through m_baseHP/m_baseStamina. Foods heal their summed m_foodRegen every 10 s. Up to 3 foods, and a food can be re-eaten at half its burn time. The profile saves max and current values, foods and Player.m_customData.

chapters.notes:
1) Authority: whoever owns a ZDO simulates it. The attacker computes outgoing HitData. The victim's owner resolves it in Character.RPC_Damage (block, armor, backstab, stagger). Monster AI, turrets and summons run on their ZDO owner, normally the nearest client (ZDOMan.ReleaseNearbyZDOS), so a dedicated server practically never runs combat logic. AI, turret and summon mods need every client. Player-side mechanics (reload, block, stealth factor, noise, stamina, food HP, adrenaline) can be client-only because they sync through the player's own ZDO (WeaponLoaded, IsBlocking, dodgeinv, Stealth, noise, stamina, eitr, adrenaline, max_health). All balance-affecting mods should still ship server-synced config (ServerSync or Jotunn).

2) Custom StatusEffects that are applied by hash (hit status effects, Aoe buffs, guardian powers, RPC_AddStatusEffect) must be registered in ObjectDB.m_StatusEffects on every client. SEManager contents are not replicated, and remote players have an empty SEMan and no Inventory, so AI logic must read ZDO data instead.

3) Per-item mod state belongs in ItemData.m_customData. It persists in inventories, containers and ground drops (1.0 ItemDrop.SaveToZDO byte-array format) and vanilla ignores it. Per-character state belongs in Player.m_customData, which is saved in the profile.

4) SharedData and Attack templates are global per prefab. Edit them in ObjectDB.Awake/CopyOtherDB postfixes, or Jotunn's OnItemsRegistered, on every ObjectDB init. They are not saved.

5) Many key methods are private (Player.SetWeaponLoaded, UpdateWeaponLoading, GetTotalFoodValue, UpdateStealth, Turret.UpdateTarget, MonsterAI.UpdateTarget, Character.RPC_Damage). Use AccessTools, a publicized assembly, and Harmony reverse patches to call protected BaseAI helpers (Flee, MoveTo, StandStillDuration).

6) Hot paths: BaseAI.IsEnemy, CanSeeTarget, Character.RPC_Damage, 20 Hz AI ticks. Keep patches allocation-free.

7) Several prefab-only values must be dumped at runtime before balancing: Player.m_maxAdrenaline and the adrenaline curves, m_staggerDamageFactor, tower shield stats, ballista target flags, and the training dummy component layout.

8) Vanilla oddities worth knowing: the UseEitr RPC is never registered; Player.m_dodgeAdrenaline is unused; BaseAI.StandStillDuration is unused; ballista bolts have a null owner and hit players and tames; SpawnAbility.m_maxSpawned counts all players' summons; Aoe.m_blockable defaults to false.

9) Suggested shared library for the Combat mods: combat context events (parry, perfect dodge, backstab, stagger, adrenaline source) exposed as C# events from a small core plugin, so the Weapon, Adrenaline, Trinket and Boss power revamps do not each patch the same methods.

systems.name: World generation
systems.summary: Pure function of World.m_seed + m_worldGenVersion; nothing saved. WorldGenerator.GetBiome decides biome in fixed order (Ashlands ring south of ~z=-8000 via Length(x,y-4000)>12000, ocean by base height<=0.02, Deep North north of ~z=+8000, mountain >0.4, then Perlin-gated swamp/mistlands/plains/black forest, meadows). GetBiomeHeight dispatches per-biome height funcs x200 with Ashlands/DN gap moats. Called from HeightmapBuilder worker thread and ~4M times at load: patches must be thread-safe and identical on all peers; changing math breaks TerrainComp deltas in existing worlds.

systems.name: Biome sectors and AltBiomes
systems.summary: New 1.0 layer: 2048x2048 12m grid flood-filled into per-biome sectors (Ashlands/DN/Ocean are single global sectors); AltBiome modifiers (vanilla AltBiomes_Erik) are rolled per sector and add/block spawns, vegetation, locations, environments, force env/music, rename biome, override terrain texture, scale level-up chance. Recomputed every load on every peer (VerifyBiomeData) so lists must match everywhere. Best data-only way to create sub-biomes (e.g. ocean reef) without touching Heightmap.Biome enum. Inject in ZoneSystem.Awake postfix.

systems.name: Heightmaps and terrain
systems.summary: Tiles built on a worker thread; biome inside a tile is a weighted pick of 4 corner sectors. Terrain texture encoded as limited vertex-color combos (DN shares Mountain channel) so a new biome texture needs shader work. Paint mask carries lava; in Deep North the cultivation channel is snow depth. Player terrain edits live in TerrainComp ZDO (s_TCData) as deltas.

systems.name: ZoneSystem (zones, vegetation, locations, global keys)
systems.summary: Server generates locations once (GenerateLocationsTimeSliced: 60000/12000 zone picks, ordered filter checks) into m_locationInstances (max 1 per zone, only ungenerated zones). Zones spawn every 0.1s: server Full/Ghost modes place locations, vegetation (seeded by world seed + zone hash + prefab hash) and _ZoneCtrl; clients use Client mode. Saved: generated zones, location instances, non-server-option global keys. Global keys are server-authoritative via SetGlobalKey RPC and broadcast; custom valued keys ('name value') persist in the world. SpawnLocationMidGame only registers; placement happens only on first zone generation.

systems.name: Locations and dungeons
systems.summary: Interiors sit at +5000y (Character.InInterior = y>3000), with a 64x500x64 EnvZone. DungeonGenerator (Dungeon/CampGrid/CampRadial) places themed rooms within m_zoneSize bounds (default 64^3) on the server and saves room hash/pos/rot list in ZDO s_roomData; clients async-load rooms and rebuild non-networked geometry as children of the generator, so a dungeon exists only while the generator's zone is loaded. Room.Theme includes NorthVillage/MorkHalla; bits 0x8000 and >=0x40000 are free. LocationProxy (s_location, s_seed) rebuilds location visuals on clients.

systems.name: Ashlands, Deep North and PersistentEventSystem
systems.summary: Ashlands: lava paint mask, boiling ocean gradient (HitType.AshlandsOcean), cinder fire spread. Deep North: deep snow via cultivation mask (movement slow, build rules), snow load on buildings (Game.m_snowSupportLevel 0.25, NoHeavySnow/AllHeavySnow), assets for FrozenKing boss, MorkHalla, BlackIce/Fimbulvinter props. Vanilla activation primitive: TriggerPersistentEventOnDestroy (destructible owner triggers/stops a PersistentEventSystem event). PersistentEventSystem (world-saved since BogWitch) holds server-authoritative area events with env override, spawn gating (SpawnData.m_requiredPersistentEvent), WearNTear event damage, minimap pins; RPC uses list index so all peers need identical event lists; RPC_RequestStartEvent never sets duration.

systems.name: Spawning and creature levels
systems.summary: SpawnSystem on each _ZoneCtrl runs only on the owning client with a local player in the zone (dedicated servers never spawn naturally): per-entry timers in the zone ctrl ZDO, checks global key/env/day-night/maxSpawned (5x5 zones via ZDO count), spawn 40-80m from a player, level roll via SpawnSystem.GetLevelUpChance (10% base; world level min(70, base^(wl*1.15)); x AltBiome multiplier). Also base, event ('e_') and AltBiome ('m{i}') lists. CreatureSpawner links to its spawn via ZDO connection + s_aliveTime and supports required/blocking global keys and group blocking. A star: HP x level, damage 1+0.5(level-1), level-multiplied drops x2^(level-1), LevelEffects visuals. Custom ZDO keys persist unless in ZDOVars.s_sessionHashes.

systems.name: Environments, weather and wind
systems.summary: Fully client-local and deterministic: env period index seeds weighted pick from BiomeEnvSetup (+AltBiome add/block) at the camera's sector; override chain in private EnvMan.GetEnvironmentOverride: debug env > intro > RandEventSystem event/boss env (in event biome) > AltBiome force > PersistentEvent env > non-forced EnvZone; forced EnvZone wins in GetCurrentEnvironment. Env drives IsWet/IsCold/IsFreezing, snow buildup, fog/light. Wind from 4 seeded octaves, outward at world edge, ship-forward with Moder power. Vanilla bug: EnvMan uses IsDeepnorth(x, y) with camera height instead of z. Nothing saved; any shared weather change needs synced state applied on every client.

systems.name: View and render distance
systems.summary: Loaded zones = SimulationDistance (setting 0..6: near 1..6, far 2; server clamps clients via RPC_RequestValidSimulationDistance, dedicated -simulationdistance). Near ring instantiates all ZDOs, far ring only m_distant ZDOs; ownership radius ~1.5 zones. TerrainLod draws a 2400m square distant terrain (3x3 regions, 10m vertices, rebuild per 256m); LOD hidden within near*sqrt2*64; water visible near*64; fog density set per env each fixed update; far clip is a prefab value; LOD bias 1/1.5/2/5; shadows 80/120/150m; grass 40m.

systems.name: Boss altars, summoning and boss AI
systems.summary: OfferingBowl.UseItem/Interact (offering client) -> RPC_SpawnBoss on the altar ZDO owner -> CanSpawnBoss (100 tries within 40m) -> DelayedSpawnBoss after 5s instantiates boss on that client; items removed via RPC back to sender; m_setGlobalKey set on offer. Boss: Character.m_boss/m_bossEvent (forced RandomEvent per client while boss HUD active, can add spawns/env/music), BaseAI.SetAlerted tracks GlobalKeys.activeBosses, Character.OnDeath sets m_defeatSetGlobalKey and routes RPC_RegisterKill to attackers. AI attacks chosen by Humanoid.EquipBestWeapon using item m_ai* fields incl. health-percentage phase gates. Drops via CharacterDrop.GenerateDropList (pseudo-random under 0.3).

systems.name: Vegvisirs, runestones and lore
systems.summary: Vegvisir/RuneStone call Game.DiscoverClosestLocation -> server RPC_DiscoverClosestLocation (only the server has the location registry) -> RPC_DiscoverLocationResponse -> Minimap.DiscoverLocation; reusable by client-only mods. RuneStone shows lore via TextViewer and Player.AddKnownText. Lore/known texts/unique keys/m_customData are per character. PinTypes include Hildir1-3 and Memorial.

systems.name: Traders and NPCs
systems.summary: Haldor, Hildir and Bog Witch all use Trader + StoreGui, which are 100% local (no RPCs, no shared stock). Stock filtered by m_requiredGlobalKey and bought m_buyKey; player-key purchases incl. 'invrows' inventory rows (Player.SetInventorySize); m_useItems turn-ins set global keys (Hildir quest: named mini-bosses drop chests -> give to Hildir -> unlocks stock and dialog). Selling sells the first valuable stack at m_value x stack. NpcTalk drives Dvergr chatter.

systems.name: Ocean and underwater
systems.summary: Water level constant 30; per-zone WaterVolume computes 10 trochoid waves from global wind scaled by ocean depth, faded near DN; surface drops 100m beyond 10500. Swimming holds characters at liquid level minus m_swimDepth (2), no diving; GameCamera clamps camera 0.3 above liquid; no underwater rendering path. Ocean content via ZoneVegetation/SpawnData/Clutter ocean-depth filters.

chapters.notes: Natural spawns, altar boss spawns, CreatureSpawner and event creatures are created by client ZDO owners (dedicated servers never run SpawnSystem because it requires a local player), so any spawn/boss/variant mod must be installed on every client and must write its decisions into the creature ZDO at creation, re-applied from the ZDO in Character.Awake on all peers. Biome map, AltBiomes, weather, waves and vegetation seeds are recomputed locally by every peer, so mods changing them must be identical everywhere (add a version handshake). Server-side persistent stores that need no custom networking are valued global keys (saved in the world, broadcast on change), ZDO fields (persisted unless listed in ZDOVars.s_sessionHashes), the PersistentEventSystem (saved, synced, shown on the minimap; RPC uses list index) and the location registry; per-character stores are Player.m_customData, unique keys and known texts. For existing worlds, new locations only appear in zones never generated (SpawnLocationMidGame only registers them), AltBiome changes apply immediately, and changing generator math corrupts TerrainComp edits. WorldGenerator.GetBiome/GetBiomeHeight run on the HeightmapBuilder worker thread. Vanilla quirks worth knowing: EnvMan calls IsDeepnorth(x, y) with camera height instead of z; AltBiomeWorldData.RandomBiomeFromBiomes skews multi-biome location sampling; OfferingBowl.RPC_SpawnBoss has an always-true guard. Trading is fully local, which makes shop mods client-only. The Hildir quest (named mini-bosses drop chests, handed in via Trader.m_useItems to set global keys that unlock stock and dialog) is a vanilla data-only template for quest content. I did not check the Deep North prop components (BlackIce/Fimbulvinter as the 'stone' triggers), the environment names or the camera far-clip value; check them in-game with the env, pevents and biomeinfo commands or by dumping components.

systems.name: Swimming
systems.summary: Character.CustomFixedUpdate -> CalculateLiquidDepth/UpdateWater (IsSwimming = m_swimTimer < 0.5, depth > m_swimDepth-0.4). Owner-only Character.UpdateSwimming applies horizontal force (y=0) and pulls the body toward liquidLevel - m_swimDepth: no vanilla dive. Player.OnSwimming drains stamina lerp(5,2,SwimSkill)/s (+equipment index 7, SE mods, Game.m_moveStaminaRate), raises Swim every 1s, drowning ceil(maxHP/20)/s at 0 stamina (HitType.Drowning). While swimming: no stamina regen (Player.UpdateStats(float)), hand items hidden (Humanoid.UpdateEquipment), EquipItem refused, crouch cancelled. GameCamera.GetCameraPosition clamps camera above water (m_minWaterDistance 0.3). Client-authoritative for the local player.

systems.name: Sailing
systems.summary: ShipControlls.Interact -> RPC RequestControl -> owner writes ZDO 'user' -> Player.StartDoodadControl/AttachStart. Input via Ship.ApplyControlls: RPC Forward/Backward step Ship.Speed (Back/Stop/Slow/Half/Full), RPC Rudder (m_rudderSpeed). Ship.CustomFixedUpdate simulates on ZDO owner only: buoyancy (5 samples), damping, sail force GetSailForce = normalize(wind+fwd)*GetWindAngleFactor*lerp(0.25,1,intensity)*m_sailForceFactor*sailSize with SmoothDamp 1s; GetWindAngleFactor best at beam reach, 0.7 tailwind, 0 within ~37-41 deg of bow; steering proportional to speed (m_stearVelForceFactor) plus paddle forces in Slow/Back. Owner writes ZDO forward/rudder. Ship.UpdateOwner moves ownership to an aboard player (helmsman not guaranteed owner). Ship.Stop exists but is unused. Wind in EnvMan.UpdateWind is deterministic from net time, Moder SailingPower sets wind to ship forward. No sailing skill in vanilla; stats DistanceSail/DistanceSailHelm in Player.UpdateStats().

systems.name: Map & minimap / cartography table
systems.summary: Minimap.UpdateExplore every 2s calls private Explore(pos, m_exploreRadius=100) - constant radius; m_explored / m_exploredOthers BitArrays + fog texture channels. Minimap.AddPin is the universal entry; it downgrades types >= enum length to Icon3 (m_visibleIconTypes sized in Minimap.Start). Dynamic pins (bed, shouts, pings, players, location icons, events) are unsaved. Map data (version 8, compressed) saved per world in the player profile via Minimap.SaveMapData/PlayerProfile.SetMapData. MapTable read: ZDO 'data' -> Minimap.AddSharedMapData merges exploration and foreign pins; write: GetSharedMapData -> RPC MapData to table owner. Vegvisir discovery via Game.DiscoverClosestLocation (server) -> Minimap.DiscoverLocation. Entirely client-local except the table ZDO and server location lookup.

systems.name: Sleeping & time
systems.summary: Day = 1200s; raw fraction rescaled (raw 0.15-0.85 -> 0.25-0.75 day). EnvMan.FixedUpdate sets static IsDay/IsAfternoon/IsNight and s_canSleep (CalculateCanSleep: afternoon or night + 30s cooldown after m_wakeupTime). Bed.Interact (client) checks CanSleep, enemies, exposure (cover>=0.8 + roof), fire, wet, then AttachStart(isBed) -> ZDO inBed. Server Game.UpdateSleeping (2s) requires afternoon/night + all character ZDOs inBed + 10s -> EnvMan.SkipToMorning (private m_skipTime/m_skipToTime/m_timeSkipSpeed=delta/12) + RPC SleepStart; EnvMan.UpdateTimeSkip advances ZNet.SetNetTime; SleepStop -> Player.SetSleeping(false) (good morning, Rested), autosave, WearNTear.OnSleep. Server-authoritative time, client-evaluated bed entry.

systems.name: Player statistics & kill tracking
systems.summary: PlayerProfile.m_playerStats[10] (0 = raw, others achievement buckets) with m_stats plus string dictionaries: m_enemyStats[5] by KillModifiers, pickups, crafts, pickables, food, pieces. Per-creature kills already exist: m_enemyStats[0][Character.m_name]. Victim owner tags attackers in Character.RPC_Damage (ZDO '<Attackers><playerName>' + Modifiers), Character.OnDeath sends RPC_RegisterKill to every attacker -> IncrementStatEnemy + EnemyKills/BossKills. Saved in the .fch profile (per character across worlds). TextsDialog.AddStats dumps stats but omits per-enemy lines.

systems.name: Lore, compendium & tutorials
systems.summary: Inventory Compendium = TextsDialog: UpdateTextsList builds entries from Player.GetKnownTexts (sorted) + AddLog + AddActiveEffects + AddStats. Player private knowledge sets saved in Player.Save: m_knownTexts, m_shownTutorials, m_knownBiome, m_knownMaterial, m_knownRecipes, m_knownStations, m_trophies, m_uniques; Player.m_customData is saved and unused by vanilla. Tutorial.m_texts triggered by global keys/other tutorials -> Raven.AddTempText; Raven.Talk and RuneStone.Interact call AddKnownText; RuneStone can discover locations. Trophy panel InventoryGui.UpdateTrophyList. All client-local.

systems.name: Skills
systems.summary: SkillType 1-14 weapons/tools, 100-108 movement/crafting, 110 Ride (no Sailing). Raise: step*factor*Game.m_skillGainRate, next level floor(l+1)^1.5*0.5+0.5, cap 100. GetSkillLevel includes SEMan.ModifySkillLevel. Death: LowerAllSkills(0.25*Game.m_skillReductionRate). Skills.Load drops types failing IsSkillValid (Enum.IsDefined) and GetSkill gives m_info=null for unknown -> custom skills need injection (Jotunn SkillManager). Effects: weapon damage/stamina (-33%), bow draw 20%, crossbow reload 50%, run drain/speed, jump +40%, swim stamina, sneak, dodge, ride, fishing, farming radius/bonus, cooking, crafting, build stamina. Only threshold mechanism: SpawnAbility.m_levelUpSettings.

systems.name: Camera & zoom
systems.summary: GameCamera.LateUpdate -> UpdateFOV (temp FOV) -> UpdateCamera: scroll/gamepad change private m_distance clamped to m_minDistance..m_maxDistance (6) or m_maxDistanceBoat when steering; first person = distance 0 (m_fpsOffset). GetCameraPosition: offsets, CollideRay2, near clipping, water clamp, ship tilt. Public SetTempFOV/ResetTempFOV (used by 1.0 GrapplingPoint) ideal for zoom; PlayerController.m_mouseSens static. Purely local.

systems.name: Equippable lights & utility slot
systems.summary: Humanoid.EquipItem: Torch goes to left hand with a one-hander else right hand; single Utility slot (BeltStrength, Wishbone, Demister) and separate Trinket slot; NG+ world-level check. UpdateEquipment drains durability incl. utility and hides hand items while swimming. VisEquipment.SetUtilityItem writes ZDO UtilityItem hash; every client's UpdateEquipmentVisuals -> SetUtilityEquipped -> AttachArmor instantiates item prefab children named attach_<Bone> under skeleton bones (lights render on all clients with the prefab). Vanilla Lantern is a Torch-type hand item (Items/weapons/Lantern.prefab).

systems.name: Skill-gated abilities (vanilla)
systems.summary: No discrete unlocks in vanilla; skills scale continuous values. Threshold precedents: SpawnAbility.m_levelUpSettings (summon level/max spawns by skill level), SE_Stats skill level modifiers, skill-dependent SE tooltips. Clean hooks for a perk framework: Skills.GetSkillLevel, Player.OnSkillLevelup, Skills.LowerAllSkills, SkillsDialog.Setup, Player.m_customData.

chapters.notes: Most systems in this area are client-authoritative (player movement, map, stats, lore, camera); sleep/time is server-authoritative and ship physics runs on the ship ZDO owner. Per-character persistence: Player.m_customData (saved, unused by vanilla). Per-item: ItemData.m_customData. Per-object: namespaced ZDO keys. Custom items are silently removed from inventories loaded without the mod (Inventory.AddItem returns false for unknown prefabs). Custom skills are filtered by Skills.IsSkillValid (Enum.IsDefined) and unknown SkillDefs cause NREs: decide project-wide between Jotunn SkillManager and an in-repo Core injector. Custom map pin types need Minimap.m_visibleIconTypes extension before map load. Many patch targets are private: use a publicized assembly_valheim reference. The vanilla Compendium (TextsDialog) and per-enemy kill stats already exist and can be extended rather than rebuilt.

systems.name: Plants, saplings and cultivated ground
systems.summary: Plant (a SlowUpdate) holds the sapling stage. Plant.UpdateHealth decides status in this order: 10 s grace, WrongBiome (m_biome), NotCultivated (Heightmap.IsCultivated: paint G > 0.5), TooHot (Ashlands outside a shield), TooCold (Mountain or DeepNorth outside a shield), NoSun (roof raycast), NoSpace (m_growRadius overlap), NoAttachPiece (vines). If there is no heightmap under the plant, the biome, heat and cold checks are skipped. The owner calls Plant.Grow once server time since s_plantTime exceeds GetGrowTime(), a seed-deterministic Lerp(m_growTime, m_growTimeMax). An unhealthy plant is destroyed only if m_destroyIfCantGrow; otherwise it waits forever. ZDO keys: s_seed and s_plantTime. Quirk: the SUpdate throttle is inverted, so UpdateHealth runs on every SlowUpdater pass. In the Deep North the cultivation G channel doubles as snow depth. The 1.0 scythe harvests through Piece.m_harvest and Piece.OnPlaced.

systems.name: Shield generator effects on plants
systems.summary: ShieldGenerator keeps a static list of loaded generators. IsInsideShield tests the current animated m_radius: min + fuelRatio*(max-min), or 0 with no fuel. Plants get TooHot or TooCold only outside a shield, so a shield also acts as a greenhouse for mountain and Deep North crops. Grown crops and trees ignore shields. Outside shields, CinderSpawner cinders can burn TreeBase and TreeLog (Cinder.CanBurn). Fuel lives in ZDO s_fuel and s_startTime drives the attack charge. The radius is 0 right after load, so custom rules need a grace period.

systems.name: Pickable and PickableItem
systems.summary: Pickable.Interact runs on the picker's client: stats, Farming skill raise, and the bonus roll (skillFactor * m_maxLevelBonusChance). It then calls RPC_Pick(bonus) on the owner, which drops ScaleDrops(m_amount)+bonus and extra drops and broadcasts RPC_SetPicked. The owner runs UpdateRespawn every 60 s against s_pickedTime and m_respawnTimeMinutes. One-shot crops are destroyed when picked. PickableItem stores a random item and stack in s_itemPrefab and s_itemStack. There is no static registry of pickables.

systems.name: Beehive
systems.summary: Every 10 s, if the biome matches m_biome and cover at m_coverPoint is below m_maxCover (0.25), the owner accumulates elapsed server time since s_lastTime into s_product and adds honey to s_level, up to m_maxHoney (4). Daylight is cosmetic. RPC_Extract on the owner spawns honey and resets the level.

systems.name: SapCollector and ResourceRoot
systems.summary: Placement requires Piece.m_mustConnectTo: the name of a nearby ZNetView must contain the prefab name (YggdrasilRoot). The collector finds a ResourceRoot within 0.2 m, and every 5 s the owner converts elapsed time into s_level (max 4), draining the root by RPC_Drain on the root's owner. ResourceRoot regenerates m_regenPerSec (1/s) up to 100 every 10 s, with 50/10 thresholds for its status. The collector and the root have independent owners.

systems.name: Taming
systems.summary: MonsterAI.UpdateConsumeItem feeds a creature from m_consumeItems when it is hungry, which resets s_tameLastFeeding. Every 3 s, Tameable.TamingUpdate (owner, not hungry, not alerted) decreases s_tameTimeLeft, doubled for each nearby player with the TamingBoost attribute. At 0, MonsterAI.MakeTame and Character.SetTamed store s_tamed. Command toggles follow (s_follow = player name) or stay (a world-space patrol point in s_patrolPoint). UpdateSavedFollowTarget re-links follow by player name. Other data: saddle, naming, unsummon. Pet is a placeable pet piece whose face variant is stored in the player unique key 'Pet'.

systems.name: Breeding and offspring growth
systems.summary: Procreation.Procreate runs every m_updateInterval on the owner. m_pregnancyChance is effectively the chance to skip a tick. The creature needs a ready partner within 3 m (procreationOnly count, self included) and fewer than m_maxCreatures nearby; love points accumulate in s_lovePoints until MakePregnant sets s_pregnant. At birth, offspring level = max(m_minOffspringLevel, the pregnant parent's own level). The partner is never recorded, and both partners can become pregnant. Eggs use SetQuality. Growup keeps the tamed flag and level (not the name) after m_growTime from s_spawnTime. EggGrow needs a stack of 1, a Heat area and a roof with at least 0.7 cover, and stores s_growStart. EnemyHud shows stars only for levels 2 and 3.

systems.name: Fishing
systems.summary: The rod's projectile attack spawns FishingFloat (an IProjectile) with the bait as ammo (s_rodOwner, s_bait). Fish within m_range (10) choose the float with m_baseHookChance, swim to it, roll the bait chance (TestBate) and send RPC_Nibble. The player must reel (hold Block) or jerk the float within 0.5 s (TryToHook). Fish.OnHooked claims fish ownership. Reeling costs stamina, shortens the line (halved while the fish escapes) and raises the skill. The line breaks when distance minus line length exceeds 4 or distance exceeds 30. FishingFloat.Catch gives the reward. The whole minigame runs on the fisher's client.

systems.name: Harpoon
systems.summary: The chitin harpoon (SpearChitin, projectile_chitinharpoon) applies SE_Harpooned through HitData.m_statusEffectHash. Projectile.IsValidTarget on the attacker rejects non-enemy targets, including tames, unless PvP is on. RPC_Damage applies the SE before damage, and zero damage exits ApplyDamage without alerting the AI. SE_Harpooned breaks on bosses and beyond 30 m. It pulls with Utils.Pull (no upward force), drains attacker stamina by target mass, and does not pull targets standing on a ship. Melee attacks have a separate m_tamedOnly filter (KnifeButcher).

systems.name: Creatures on ships
systems.summary: The Ship trigger counts InNumShipVolumes for any Character, but only Players drive ship logic and ownership. ApplyGroundForce attaches a standing, non-moving character to a ship-local offset: a velocity correction if the same client owns the ship, otherwise a hard position set. Any move intent detaches it. m_characterParentSync syncs the position relative to the ground ZDO. Tamed idle AI random-walks, and a 'stay' patrol point is stored in world space, so tames walk off moving decks. Pathfinding fails on moving decks. The creature's owner can differ from the ship's owner, which causes jitter.

systems.name: Portals and teleport
systems.summary: Portals pair by tag on the server (Game.ConnectPortals, ConnectionType.Portal). TeleportWorldTrigger fires only for the local player. TeleportWorld.Teleport checks target, NoPortals, NoBossPortals and IsTeleportable (tool tier 1000 or more always blocks; m_allowAllItems or TeleportAll bypasses the item rules), then calls Player.TeleportTo(distant). UpdateTeleport moves the player after 2 s and waits for the area and floor (8-15 s). Character.TeleportTo returns false for non-players and no creature ever moves; tames re-follow by name when the player returns.

systems.name: Minimap icons
systems.summary: Vanilla has no pins for creatures, tames or gatherables. Minimap.AddPin is public; its m_icon can be overwritten afterwards with any sprite, including item icons. Use save:false for dynamic pins and move them by writing m_pos. UpdatePins honours type filters, doubleSize, animate and worldSize. Fog is explored every 2 s within m_exploreRadius (100). Sources: Character.GetAllCharacters or BaseAI.BaseAIInstances for creatures, a self-built Pickable registry, or ZDOMan queries.

systems.name: Food
systems.summary: SharedData holds m_food, m_foodStamina, m_foodEitr, m_foodBurnTime, m_foodRegen, m_isDrink and m_consumeStatusEffect. A player has at most 3 foods. Re-eating or replacing a food is allowed once remaining time is below half the burn time. Food value = base * (t/burn)^0.3, updated every second times Game.m_foodRate. m_foodRegen heals every 10 s. The save stores prefab name and time, and loading rebuilds from the prefab's ItemData, so per-instance data is lost.

systems.name: CookingStation
systems.summary: UpdateCooking runs every 1 s. The owner adds catch-up delta time (s_startTime) to each slot. At m_cookTime an item becomes Done, and at twice that it becomes Burnt (m_overCookedItem). The station needs fire (EffectArea Burning at m_fireCheckPoints) or fuel (s_fuel, m_secPerFuel). Adding food calls RPC_AddItem on the owner. Taking food rolls a client-side bonus (skill * 0.25) and calls RPC_RemoveDoneItem. Slot data uses string keys 'slot{i}' (a string and a float under the same key) and 'slotstatus{i}'.

systems.name: Fermenter
systems.summary: Adding an item requires a roof and cover of at least 0.7; the owner sets s_content (name hash) and s_startTime. The barrel is Ready when elapsed time exceeds m_fermentationDuration (2400 s). When exposed, UpdateCover resets the timer instead of pausing it. RPC_Tap followed by DelayedTap spawns m_producedItems (4).

systems.name: Feasts
systems.summary: A feast is a placed piece with m_eatStacks portions in s_value. Interact checks CanConsumeItem, then RPC_TryEat on the owner decrements the stack, followed by RPC_OnEat to everybody and RPC_EatConfirmation to the eater (SE plus EatFood). Feasts and food items are placed with the Serving Tray (Feaster, _FeasterPieceTable). Dismantling refunds resources scaled by the remaining stack. The piece unlocks once all its resources are known materials. Prefabs: Feast<Biome> and <Biome>_Material for Meadows, BlackForest, Swamps, Mountains, Plains, Mistlands, Ashlands, DeepNorth and Oceans. The recipe station and level are prefab data.

systems.name: Cauldron and food crafting stations
systems.summary: The cauldron (piece_cauldron) level is 1 plus the distinct extensions within m_maxStationDistance. Extensions: spice rack, butcher table, pots, mortar, rolling pins, smoker (cauldron_ext1,3,4,5,6,7). CheckUsable enforces roof (cover of at least 0.7) and fire. Known station levels are updated within m_discoverRange (4 m) or on placement. The DoCrafting cooking bonus is skill * 0.25 per unit, for stackable results only. Other food stations: piece_preptable, piece_MeadCauldron, piece_cookingstation(_iron), piece_oven, fermenter.

systems.name: Recipe discovery and unlock
systems.summary: A recipe becomes known when its station is known at m_minStationLevel and every ingredient is in m_knownMaterial, meaning it was ever picked up; m_requireOnlyOneIngredient needs just one. Pieces in owned piece tables unlock the same way (AddKnownPiece, with the msg_newdish message for food, meads and feasts). Crafting needs the station in use at level m_minStationLevel + quality - 1. Known recipes, materials, stations and biomes persist in the player profile. Biome knowledge (m_knownBiome) exists but is not used for recipes.

chapters.notes:
1. Almost every farming and cooking system is owner-authoritative ZDO state driven by server time (ZNet.GetTime ticks), and the owner is whichever client is nearby (ZDOMan.ReleaseNearbyZDOS). Logic changes therefore need everyone to install the mod. The client-only exceptions are fishing, harpoon targeting, portal creature moves, minimap tracking and multi-planting.
2. Tuning values (grow times, biome masks, bait tables, cook times, feast recipe stations and levels) are prefab data, not visible in the decompiled code. Build a dev dump plugin in the tooling phase (ZNetScene.m_prefabs, ObjectDB.m_recipes). Prefab names in the doc were verified against StreamingAssets/SoftRef/manifest_extended and the localization in resources.assets, but no prefab field values could be read because the bundles are compressed and no Python/UnityPy is available.
3. Notable quirks found:
   - The Plant.SUpdate throttle is inverted, so it runs every SlowUpdater pass.
   - Procreation.m_pregnancyChance is effectively the chance to skip a tick; both parents can become pregnant.
   - Growup drops the tame's name.
   - Fermenter exposure resets progress instead of pausing it.
   - Food loaded from a save loses per-instance item data.
   - The DoCrafting multi-craft bonus compounds.
   - The 'stay' patrol point is stored in world space, which makes tames walk off moving ships.
   - Character.TeleportTo is a no-op for non-players.
   - The Deep North reuses the cultivation paint channel as snow depth.
4. Patchable private methods: InvokeRepeating targets patch fine. Avoid tiny getters (inlining risk).
5. Existing mods to respect: Advize PlantEasily / PlantEverything (the user's 'exists' ideas), AllTameable-style taming mods, star-level mods, ValheimRAFT-style ship mods, pin managers.
6. Sibling chapters already cover CraftingStation/Recipe (building-crafting.md), sailing and map (exploration-player.md), and minimap pins (ux.md). This chapter cross-references them.

systems.name: Piece placement
systems.summary: Player.UpdatePlacement drives build mode. Player.SetupPlacementGhost builds a stripped ghost. Player.UpdatePlacementGhost is the single place that decides m_placementStatus (ray test, piece flags, a hit WearNTear with m_supports=false makes it Invalid, snapping via children tagged 'snappoint' within 0.5 m, ward/no-build/biome checks). TryPlacePiece re-runs it, then PlacePiece instantiates the piece (placer owns the ZDO), sets s_creator and calls IPlaced.OnPlaced. Costs go through Player.ConsumeResources. Everything is client-side; nothing is validated by the server.

systems.name: WearNTear & stability
systems.summary: The owner-only UpdateWear handles rain, support, snow, ash/lava and biome damage. UpdateSupport treats terrain or non-WNT colliders as full support and neighbours only when their m_supports is true; per-material support/loss table is in GetMaterialProperties. ZDO keys: s_health, s_support, s_snow. Damage goes through RPC_Damage on the owner; wards only flash. ShieldGenerator suppresses wear inside its dome.

systems.name: Fireplace (fires, torches, sconces)
systems.summary: Only the owner burns fuel (UpdateFireplace every 2 s, s_fuel, s_lastTime) when the fire is burning, not infinite, and s_state==1. IsBurning returns true at 0 fuel when m_infiniteFuel. Interact toggles (RPC_ToggleOn) only if m_canTurnOff && !alt && fuel>0; otherwise it adds fuel (RPC_AddFuel). GetHoverText is empty for infinite fuel. UpdateState auto-turns off turn-off-able fires when wet. Patch prefab flags at ZNetScene.Awake.

systems.name: Sign
systems.summary: Interact checks the ward and UGC privileges, then opens TextInput (50 chars). SetText claims ownership and writes s_text, s_author, s_authorDisplayName directly. UpdateText (every 2 s on DataRevision change) applies permission/censor filtering.

systems.name: Container (chests)
systems.summary: Opening sends RPC_RequestOpen to the owner, who transfers ZDO ownership to the requester. The viewer edits the Inventory locally and Save writes s_items (the byte array includes m_customData). Stack-all and take-all follow the same ownership handoff. Privacy Group always denies. A vanilla RPC name mismatch ('discovered' vs 'RPC_Discovered') means the discovered flag is never set.

systems.name: Ward (PrivateArea)
systems.summary: ZDO holds s_enabled, s_permitted and pu_id{i}/pu_name{i}; RPCs are ToggleEnabled, TogglePermitted and FlashShield. The static CheckAccess is evaluated on the acting client (build, remove, repair, doors/chests with m_checkGuardStone, signs, stands, portals, terrain ops, etc.). It is not called for pickables, plants, smelters, cooking stations, fireplaces, tames or damage. OnObjectDamaged only flashes, so there is no server enforcement.

systems.name: CraftingStation & extensions
systems.summary: Interact runs CheckUsable (roof with at least 70% cover, fire via EffectArea), then SetCraftingStation and InventoryGui.Show(null,3). Level = 1 + extensions found by StationExtension.FindExtensions (same m_name, within 5 m, re-scanned every 2 s). Build range = m_rangeBuild + ext*m_extraRangePerLevel. There is no station ZDO state; known station levels are stored per player (AddKnownStation). m_upgrader marks the Forge of Potential.

systems.name: Recipe & requirements
systems.summary: GetRequiredStationLevel(q) = max(1,min) + q - 1. Requirement.GetAmount(q) scales by level; upgrader resources add m_amount. At an upgrader station, Player.HaveRequirementItems, ConsumeResources and GetFirstRequiredItem count only m_upgraderResource requirements, and RequiredCraftingStation is always true. Discovery happens in UpdateKnownRecipesList, availability in GetAvailableRecipes. Register recipes in both ObjectDB.Awake and CopyOtherDB.

systems.name: InventoryGui crafting/upgrade/repair
systems.summary: UpdateRecipe decides whether the craft button is interactable and runs the timer (2 s, multi-craft x5 in 6 s, upgrader 8 s + 1 s per level, skill -60%). DoCrafting is the core rule: an upgrade removes the old item and re-adds a new one, losing m_customData and resetting durability, crafter and worldLevel. RepairOneItem repairs the first repairable worn item and returns (one per click); CanRepair requires a station match and min(level,4) >= m_minStationLevel. Variants can only be picked at craft time.

systems.name: Forge of Potential (upgrader)
systems.summary: CraftingStation.m_upgrader ($piece_upgradestation) refines items beyond m_maxQuality using Idol items (Battle/Protection, tiers 0-7 Wooden..Bloodgold). Outcome uses the first upgrader requirement's m_upgradeChance (default .65); a break happens if m_breakChance >= 1-r (default .1) and returns m_breakReturnIngreientsAmount of recoverable mats. Otherwise the item drops 1 level. Idols are consumed in every case. m_successUpgradeSteps is unused. Vanilla bug: $msg_upgrader_failed has no localization (the key is msg_upgrader_fail).

systems.name: Smelter family feeding
systems.summary: Child Switches (m_addOreSwitch, m_addWoodSwitch, m_emptyOreSwitch) call OnAddOre/OnAddFuel, which check capacity against the local ZDO, remove one item and send RPC_AddOre(name,cheated)/RPC_AddFuel. The owner handlers do not check capacity. The owner simulates UpdateSmelter every 1 s with an accumulator capped at 3600 s; Windmill power scales it. ZDO keys: s_fuel, s_queued, item0..N, s_bakeTimer, s_accTime, s_startTime, s_spawnOre, s_spawnAmount. Switch.Interact ignores alt (Shift).

systems.name: Incinerator (Obliterator)
systems.summary: Lever sends RPC_RequestIncinerate to the owner. The coroutine applies IncineratorConversion.AttemptCraft by priority, then the default result per m_defaultCost, and replaces the container contents. Owner-side and data-driven, which makes it a good item sink.

systems.name: Trinkets & adrenaline pop
systems.summary: ItemType.Trinket (24) occupies a single slot, Humanoid.m_trinketItem, synced via s_trinketItem. It cannot be equipped if its worldLevel is below the world's. SharedData.m_maxAdrenaline is equipment modifier index 10. When Player.AddAdrenaline reaches max, every equipped item's m_fullAdrenalineSE is applied and adrenaline resets. m_equipStatusEffect is applied by Humanoid.UpdateEquipmentStatusEffects. Trinkets are crafted with normal recipes.

systems.name: Trophies & CharacterDrop
systems.summary: ItemType.Trophy (13). Player.AddTrophy stores prefab names; UpdateTrophyList lays them out by m_trophyPos with <name>_lore text. CharacterDrop.GenerateDropList applies level multipliers and pseudo-random smoothing for chances <= 0.3. Drops happen on the creature's ZDO owner in Character.OnDeath, or are deferred to a Ragdoll. ItemStand saves the full ItemData, including m_customData.

systems.name: Gems & magic weapon variants
systems.summary: The gems are Bloodstone (red), Iolite (blue) and Jade (green). They are only used as recipe resources and sold client-side via StoreGui.SellItem (m_value). Ashlands and Deep North elemental weapons are separate prefabs with their own recipes (Recipe_*_Blood/_Lightning/_Nature, *Gold_BloodLightning); there is no gem-specific code.

systems.name: Item appearance (variants/ItemStyle)
systems.summary: m_variant indexes m_icons, and ItemStyle.Setup sets the _Style shader property. Variant sync exists only for the left item, left back item and shoulder slots (s_leftItemVariant, s_leftBackItemVariant, s_shoulderItemVariant); chest/legs/helmet have none. Barber and PlayerCustomizaton handle hair, beard and colors only.

systems.name: Enchant-like mechanics & per-item data
systems.summary: There is no vanilla enchanting. Quality (including beyond max via the Forge), world level, element variant prefabs and set/equip SEs cover similar ground. Extension points: ItemData.m_customData (serialized everywhere, unused by vanilla, wiped on upgrade), Player.m_customData, the ItemData getters (GetDamage/GetArmor/...), the static ItemData.GetTooltip, and Humanoid.UpdateEquipmentStatusEffects.

systems.name: Magic in non-combat systems
systems.summary: SE_Stats m_skillLevel and m_raiseSkill modify skill level and XP gain (Skills.GetSkillLevel goes through SEMan.ModifySkillLevel), which affects craft bonus and speed, harvest radius, fishing and cooking. StatusEffect.m_attributes (ColdResistance, DoubleImpactDamage, SailingPower, TamingBoost) are synced via ZDOVars.s_seAttrib, so other owners can query them with HaveStatusAttribute; mods can add new bits. ShieldGenerator lets plants survive extreme biomes.

chapters.notes: Key facts verified in the code: (1) ZDO ownership belongs to a nearby player's client (ZDOMan.ReleaseNearbyZDOS), not the dedicated server. InvokeRPC without a target goes to the owner, and InvokeRoutedRPC runs immediately when the target is the local peer. Simulation mods (fuel, smelting, support, damage, drops) need everyone; input/UI/inventory mods can be client-only. (2) Crafting, upgrading, refinement and repair are 100% local in InventoryGui; DoCrafting re-creates upgraded items, wiping m_customData and resetting durability, crafter and worldLevel. This matters for any per-item data mod and for EpicLoot compatibility. (3) Vanilla bugs found: the Forge failure message key $msg_upgrader_failed doesn't exist (localization has msg_upgrader_fail); Container.Interact invokes 'discovered' but registers 'RPC_Discovered'; SharedData.m_successUpgradeSteps is never read; the DoCrafting bonus loop adds a cumulative bonus. (4) The Forge of Potential is CraftingStation.m_upgrader ($piece_upgradestation) with Idol catalysts (Battle/Protection x 8 tiers); per-idol chances are prefab data. (5) Variant sync exists only for the left, left-back and shoulder slots. (6) StatusEffect attribute bits sync via ZDOVars.s_seAttrib and are a clean MP-safe channel for 'magic buff affects objects owned by others'. (7) Register new content in both ObjectDB.Awake and ObjectDB.CopyOtherDB plus ZNetScene; missing prefabs are dropped from inventories and destroyed by the server/host. (8) Many prefab values (idol chances, which fireplaces can turn off, smelter capacities, chest m_supports, trophy coverage) are not in code: Appendix A of the doc lists the runtime dump we should build into the shared dev-tools project first. No Python is available on this machine (use PowerShell or the dotnet tooling for scripts).

systems.name: Inventory model
systems.summary: The grid is a flat List<ItemData> m_inventory, and each item carries its own m_gridPos. AddItem(ItemData) fills stacks one unit at a time through FindFreeStackItem (matching name, quality and worldLevel), then uses FindEmptySlot(TopFirst). TopFirst sends weapons, tools, shields, utility, misc and trinkets to the top rows; everything else fills from the bottom row up. MoveAll is Take all, StackAll is Place stacks (only item names the container already holds; equipped items are skipped). The private Inventory.Changed updates weight, shows the cheated-item messages and fires m_onChanged. There is no vanilla sort. GetAllItems returns the live list. IsSameType ignores m_customData. The player grid is 8x4 and can grow to 9 rows via Player.SetInventorySize and the 'invrows' unique key, which traders sell through StoreGui (TradeItem.m_incrementKey). Vanilla 1.0 has no bag items; 'bags' means the player inventory, carts (Vagon.m_container), ship containers and tombstones.

systems.name: Inventory screen (grids, drag/split, container panel)
systems.summary: InventoryGui.Show(container, activeGroup) and Hide() drive the screen; IsVisible() is m_hiddenFrames<=1. While the screen is shown, Update closes it on Inventory, Use, Escape, JoyB or JoyY, unless Chat has focus. InventoryGrid.UpdateGui (private) rebuilds m_elements (index y*w+x) whenever the grid size changes and repaints every slot every frame, including the tooltip of the hovered slot. OnLeftDown sets the modifier: Shift splits, Ctrl moves. InventoryGui.OnSelectedItem is the core rule for drag, swap, merge, quick-move, drop and split. The container panel only shows while Container.IsOwner(), auto-closes beyond 4 m, and holding Use triggers StackAll. Gamepad groups: 0 container, 1 player, 2 side panels, 3 crafting.

systems.name: Crafting panel and recipe list
systems.summary: CraftingStation.Interact calls Show(null,3). UpdateCraftingPanel (private) runs only on show, tab switch, craft or drop. It calls Player.GetAvailableRecipes, which already applies the vanilla static filter Player.s_FilterCraft (console filtercraft; OR matching on prefab name, token or localized name), then UpdateRecipeList. UpdateRecipeList recreates the list rows and sorts them by the 'sortcraft' unique key into InventoryGui.SortMethod (Original, Name, Type or Weight; Count has no case). UpdateRecipe runs every frame: description, requirements and craft button. Multi-craft is x5 while Shift is held. Craft time is 2 s, 6 s for multi-craft, or 8 s plus 1 s per level for upgraders, reduced by skill. DoCrafting handles the bonus roll and resource consumption. RepairOneItem repairs one item per click.

systems.name: Containers and ownership
systems.summary: Interact checks the ward and privacy (Group privacy is always denied), then sends RPC_RequestOpen to the ZDO owner. The owner rejects the request if the container is in use; otherwise it calls ForceSendZDO and SetOwner(requester) and replies RPC_OpenResponse, which opens InventoryGui.Show. RPC_RequestStack and RPC_RequestTakeAll follow the same pattern. The owner mirrors m_inUse into ZDO s_inUse. Changes are saved to ZDO s_items (Inventory.Save v109) when the local client is owner. Other clients reload every second (CheckForChanges) when DataRevision changes. Ownership stays with the last opener. Vanilla bug: RPC_Discovered is registered, but the call site invokes 'discovered'.

systems.name: Item pickup
systems.summary: Player.AutoPickup (private, FixedUpdate) scans an OverlapSphere of 2 m on the 'item' layer (100-collider buffer). It skips items with m_autoPickup false, pieces and owned quest items. It requests ZDO ownership when needed, checks space and weight, pulls the item at 15 m/s and picks it up within 0.3 m. The V key toggles the private static m_enableAutoPickup. ItemDrop.CanPickup enforces a 0.5 s spawn delay and requires ownership; RequestOwn retries with exponential backoff. Humanoid.Pickup is the core rule: inventory AddItem, network destroy, auto-equip, and the '$msg_added' message. OnPlayerDrop sets m_autoPickup false on the dropper's own instance only. ItemDrop.SlowUpdate handles despawn after 3600 s and auto-stacking when more than 200 drops exist.

systems.name: HUD and MessageHud notifications
systems.summary: Top-left: one text and one icon; the queue releases at most one message per second, each fades over 4 s, and consecutive identical messages merge as xN. Center: one text, overwritten immediately, 4 s fade. Unlocks: 4 slots (m_maxUnlockMessages) spaced 110 px, lifetime driven by the Animator 'done' tag. Biome messages wait for the top-left queue to empty. The log keeps 50 entries and is shown in the Texts dialog, but Player.Message defaults to log=false. MessageAll uses the routed RPC 'ShowMessage'; messages to a remote player use the RPC 'Message'. UpdateMessage also drains the shared cross-fade buffer one entry per frame. Hud handles hover text (UpdateCrosshair), BuildUi, the radial menu, and Ctrl+F3 hide (IsUserHidden).

systems.name: Chat, shouts and pings
systems.summary: SendPing broadcasts the routed RPC 'ChatMessage'(pos, 3, UserInfo, "") to everyone. Pings can only be sent from the large map (middle-click, double-click with the ping icon selected, or gamepad X). OnNewChatMessage checks platform permissions, strips '<' and '>', and may censor. In no-map worlds it drops pings further than 50 m. AddInworldText (private) keeps one world text per sender, rendered as 'Name: PING', with a 5 s TTL. Talker whisper/normal/shout ranges are 4/15/70 m. Vanilla servers relay any routed RPC, and unknown method hashes are ignored silently, so custom routed RPCs are safe.

systems.name: Minimap pins and pings
systems.summary: UpdateDynamicPins refreshes ping, shout, player, location and event pins. UpdatePingPins (private) turns Chat ping texts into animated, double-size PinType.Ping pins. AddPin(pos,type,name,save,...) returns PinData, and m_icon can take any sprite. Saved pins are written by the private GetMapData (version 8, compressed) into PlayerProfile world data. Invalid PinType values are coerced to Icon3, so custom pins should use PinType.None with save:false. Pins are shared through MapTable (ZDO s_data) and shared pins carry an ownerID. m_nomapPingDistance is 50. Pin sizes are 32 (small map) and 48 (large map).

systems.name: Input (ZInput)
systems.summary: ZInput is built on the Unity Input System. Buttons are ButtonDefs in the private m_buttons, created by the private AddButton inside ResetKBMButtons and the gamepad layout builders. Queries: GetButtonDown/GetButton(name), GetKeyDown(KeyCode) (low level, reads Keyboard.current), and ResetButtonStatus. Rebindable buttons are saved as PlatformPrefs 'kbmBinding_<name>'. Options for custom keys: (1) a BepInEx KeyboardShortcut polled via ZInput.GetKeyDown; (2) reflecting AddButton in a ResetKBMButtons postfix, which still does not show in the Settings list because that list is prefab data. Gameplay input is gated by Player.TakeInput and PlayerController.TakeInput.

systems.name: UI toolkit (TMP, gui_framework, navigation, radial)
systems.summary: All text is TextMeshPro; clone existing TMP texts to inherit the game fonts. GuiInputField (a TMP_InputField) supports the virtual keyboard. Input fields to clone: BuildUi.m_searchField (private; the 1.0 build search, reference logic in BuildUi.UpdateSearch), TextInput.m_inputField and Chat.m_input. UIGroupHandler gives priority-based gamepad focus groups. UIInputHandler provides click delegates, including middle click. The 1.0 radial menu (RadialBase and IRadialConfig) suits gamepad wheels. The Localize component re-localizes cloned labels.

systems.name: Settings menu
systems.summary: TabHandler pages implement ISettingsTab and apply on OK. Values are stored in PlatformPrefs (EnableConsole, KeyHints, ConsoleBindings, language, kbmBinding_*). The key list is a serialized List<KeySetting>. Recommendation: BepInEx config plus ConfigurationManager for mod options, and Player.m_customData for per-character state.

systems.name: Localization
systems.summary: Localize replaces $words; missing words render as [word]. $KEY_<btn> resolves to the bound key, or the Joy glyph when a gamepad is active. Localize(text, words) substitutes $1..$n. Results are cached in an LRU of 100 entries. Translations load from CSV TextAssets. There is no public add API: postfix SetupLanguage, call the private AddWord by reflection, and evict m_cache. Prefix mod tokens with $vm_.

systems.name: Tooltips
systems.summary: UITooltip is a single static tooltip; Set(topic,text,anchor) returns early when nothing changed. The static ItemDrop.ItemData.GetTooltip(item, quality, crafting, worldLevel, stack, appending) builds item text. InventoryGrid.CreateItemTooltip calls it every frame for the hovered slot, and crafting and store screens also use it. World hover text comes from Hoverable.GetHoverText via Hud.UpdateCrosshair.

systems.name: UI state checks and input blocking
systems.summary: The state checks are IsVisible/IsOpen/HasFocus and similar calls; the full list is in doc §14. Chat.HasFocus is checked by InventoryGui.Update, Player.TakeInput, PlayerController.TakeInput, GameCamera, Minimap, StoreGui and TextInput. A postfix that ORs in a custom text field's focus is the smallest way to stop typed keys (Tab, E, Esc, hotbar keys) from triggering the game. Console binds in Chat.Update still need a separate guard.

systems.name: Terminal and console commands
systems.summary: Commands register into the static Terminal.commands through the ConsoleCommand constructor; vanilla registers them in the private static InitTerminal. Cheat commands require confirmcheats and permanently mark the profile m_usedCheats (achievements), so mod commands should use isCheat:false. remoteCommand forwards to the server. UX-relevant vanilla commands: filtercraft, sortcraft, inventorysize, bind/unbind/resetbinds.

chapters.notes: All seven ideas are client-side. Only the ping revamp puts new data on other players' screens, and it degrades to vanilla pings for players without the mod; a vanilla dedicated server relays unknown routed RPCs and ignores unknown method hashes. Container edits are safe while InventoryGui shows the container, because the panel only renders when Container.IsOwner() is true. Vanilla already contains useful backends: Player.s_FilterCraft (filtercraft), the 'sortcraft' unique key with InventoryGui.SortMethod, the BuildUi search field and its UpdateSearch logic, inventory rows via 'invrows' and SetInventorySize, and the MessageHud log. Recommended shared VM.Common.UI library: clone helpers for vanilla buttons and search fields (no AssetBundles), a Chat.HasFocus focus-block registry that also guards console binds, localization registration (SetupLanguage postfix plus reflected AddWord and cache eviction), an Inventory.Changed reverse patch, and one stack-merge and sort routine that never merges items with differing m_customData (EpicLoot). Store per-character settings in Player.m_customData, not player unique keys, because unique keys trigger ZoneSystem.UpdateWorldRates. Use isCheat:false for debug commands, because cheat commands permanently taint the profile's 1.0 achievements. Vanilla bug noted: Container registers RPC_Discovered but invokes 'discovered'.

systems.name: Boot sequence & plugin timing
systems.summary: BepInEx plugins' Awake runs from the UnityEngine.GameObject static constructor, before any scene Awake, so no game singletons exist yet (Localization.instance must not be touched either). Menu: FejdStartup.Awake (args, AwakePlatforms, Console → Terminal.InitTerminal, ZInput) → FejdStartup.Start (SetupGui shows the isModded label, SetupObjectDB = AddComponent<ObjectDB> + CopyOtherDB). The main scene loads via SystemResourceManager.FastLoadScene. In it: ZNet.Awake creates ZRoutedRpc and ZDOMan (and resets session hashes); ZNetScene.Awake builds the prefab dictionary; ObjectDB.Awake runs; Game.Awake loads the PlayerProfile; then ZNet.Start does world load or client connect. Game.FixedUpdate → UpdateRespawn → SpawnPlayer (SetLocalPlayer, LoadPlayerData → Player.Load, OnSpawned, m_playerInitialSpawn). The whole main scene is destroyed and recreated on every join, so registrations must re-run per session and stay idempotent.

systems.name: Content registries (ObjectDB / ZNetScene)
systems.summary: Identity is prefab name → GetStableHashCode. GetPrefabName truncates at a space or '(', so mod prefab names must avoid both. ObjectDB holds m_items, m_recipes, m_StatusEffects and m_terrainOps (new in 1.0), indexed by the private UpdateRegisters (Dictionary.Add, so duplicates throw). ZNetScene holds m_prefabs → the private m_namedPrefabs. Every networked prefab, including item world-objects, must be registered there. Register content in a ZNetScene.Awake prefix plus ObjectDB.Awake and CopyOtherDB postfixes, then re-run UpdateRegisters. Items missing at Player.Load are silently dropped and lost at the next save. A host without the mod destroys ZDOs of unknown prefabs (ZNetScene.CreateObjectsSorted). Edits to prefab assets persist across sessions.

systems.name: Transport, peers, handshake & version checks
systems.summary: OnNewConnection registers peer RPCs, and the client immediately sends ServerHandshake. The sequence is RPC_ServerHandshake → ClientHandshake → SendPeerInfo → RPC_PeerInfo. Only the network version (const 40, inlined) is compared, producing Error(3)/ErrorVersion on mismatch. The server also checks the ban/white list, Steam ticket, PlayFab block/crossplay/auth, the 10-player cap (const), password or invite key, and already-connected. On success it adds the peer to ZDOMan and ZRoutedRpc (m_onNewPeer). There is no mod or isModded flag in the handshake, so mod parity needs a custom peer RPC registered in an OnNewConnection postfix and checked in an RPC_PeerInfo prefix. Periodic data every 2 s: NetTime and player list from the server; ServerSyncedPlayerData (the public m_serverSyncedPlayerData dict) from clients. IsDedicated() is hard-coded per build (client false, server true). ZRpc timeout is 30 s (90 s long). Steam send rate is pinned at 153600 B/s.

systems.name: ZDO data model & replication
systems.summary: A ZDO is a record (uid, position, rotation, prefab hash, Persistent/Distant/Type flags, OwnerRevision/DataRevision). Its key/values live in static per-type dictionaries in ZDOExtraData. ZDO.Set has no ownership check and bumps DataRevision on change. ZDOMan.SendZDOs sends whole ZDOs every 50 ms per peer within a 10 KB budget. RPC_ZDOData applies incoming data only if its DataRevision is newer, with no merge, so only the owner should write. Destroy works only for the owner (DestroyZDO routed RPC), and the server tombstones dead ZDOs. Non-persistent ZDOs are not saved and are destroyed when their owner leaves or unloads them. Session-only keys (ZDOExtraData.AddSessionHash) are synced but not saved; the set is cleared per session, so re-add after ZNet.Awake, on the server too. ZDOVars has ~200 canonical keys, e.g. s_weaponLoaded, s_items, s_itemData, s_adrenaline, s_seAttrib.

systems.name: Ownership & authority model
systems.summary: Every 2 s the server releases persistent ZDOs that left their owner's active area and assigns unowned or out-of-range ones to a peer that has them in range (server ref pos first, then peers in list order). Unowned objects are not simulated. The owner runs AI, physics, damage resolution, SEs and station logic. Canonical patterns: request → owner applies (Damage/RPC_Damage, RPC_AddStatusEffect, RPC_Heal, RPC_AddAdrenaline); exclusive edit by ownership hand-off (Container: RequestOpen → ForceSendZDO + SetOwner → OpenResponse); owner writes a ZDO bool and others read it (Player.SetWeaponLoaded/IsWeaponLoaded). The server is authoritative for global keys, net time, saves, events and portal links. Remote Player instances have empty inventories.

systems.name: ZNetView & RPCs
systems.summary: ZNetView binds a GameObject to its ZDO (m_persistent, m_distant, m_type, m_syncInitialScale). Always check IsValid(). Register/InvokeRPC: InvokeRPC(method) targets the owner; Everybody=0 targets all peers including self. ZNetView.Awake destroys the ZNetView component if m_forceDisableInit is set or ZDOMan is null; otherwise it creates a ZDO, so prefabs must be cloned under an inactive parent. LoadFields applies per-instance public-field overrides from 'HasFields' ZDO keys (written by the spawn command). ZRoutedRpc routes through the server. Register uses Dictionary.Add, so duplicates throw; unknown methods are ignored, which keeps vanilla clients safe. The sender id is self-reported and spoofable, so privileged actions should use a peer ZRpc with a socket-identity admin check. Allowed RPC parameter types: int/uint/long/float/double/bool/string/ZPackage/List<string>/Vector3/Quaternion/ZDOID/HitData/ISerializableParameter.

systems.name: Persistence (world save, player profile, global keys)
systems.summary: The world is saved by the server on a background thread, in the 1.0 chunked format (worlds_local/<name>/ with db2, fwl2, chunk files and an OK marker), with WorldSaveStarted/Finished hooks. Autosave runs every 1800 s. The character (.fch) is client-side: stats, per-world spawn/logout/map data, and the Player.Save blob (inventory, recipes, uniques, skills, Player.m_customData, build favorites). Player.m_customData is per character across worlds, local only and user-editable. Status effects are not saved. Custom skills are dropped by Skills.IsSkillValid unless patched. Global keys ('name value') are persisted by the server, settable by any client (no admin check) and broadcast whole. World modifiers feed the static rates in Game.UpdateWorldRates (m_staminaRate, m_adrenalineRate, m_worldLevel, etc.), which mods must respect.

systems.name: Item data model
systems.summary: ItemData holds per-instance fields (stack, durability, quality, variant, worldLevel, pickedUp, crafter, m_customData, gridPos, equipped, m_cheated, m_dropPrefab). SharedData holds per-type config (itemType, attacks incl. m_requiresReload, armor/damage, status effects, m_buildPieces). m_shared appears to be shared by reference at runtime: ObjectDB.m_itemByData is keyed by the SharedData reference, and re-linking happens only in the editor; this is flagged for a one-time runtime check. Clone() is MemberwiseClone plus a copy of the m_customData dictionary. ItemData.Save (v109) includes m_customData and is used by the player inventory, container ZDOs (s_items), world items (s_itemData) and item stands, so custom data follows the item everywhere. Stacking (IsSameType/FindFreeStackItem) ignores m_customData, so use it on non-stackables only. Items with more than 10000 total damage are auto-flagged cheated.

systems.name: Status effects
systems.summary: A StatusEffect is a ScriptableObject whose identity is NameHash() = asset name hash. Registration is via ObjectDB.m_StatusEffects (linear lookup). SEMan.AddStatusEffect routes non-owner calls through RPC_AddStatusEffect to the owner. The owner clones the template (CanAdd, Clone, Setup, SetLevel), ticks it in SEMan.Update (called from Character.CustomFixedUpdate) and mirrors attribute bits to the ZDO s_seAttrib. Effects live only on the owner and are not saved. The Modify* virtual family (including ModifyAdrenaline, ModifyStagger, stamina variants) is the intended extension surface.

systems.name: Localization
systems.summary: A lazy singleton that loads CSV TextAssets for the selected language (SetupLanguage). Localize() replaces $tokens, resolves $KEY_<Action> to bound keys, yields [token] for missing words, and caches results in a 100-entry LRU (placeholders included). AddWord is private: mods add strings in a SetupLanguage postfix via reflection or a publicizer, before first use. OnLanguageChange lets UI refresh. It is local only, so send tokens over the network, not text.

systems.name: Input & keybinds
systems.summary: ZInput wraps the Unity Input System; the game never uses legacy Input. Named actions (Attack, Block, Use, Hotbar1..8, Joy*) are built by the private AddButton/ResetKBMButtons, and rebinds persist as PlatformPrefs kbmBinding_<Name>. Query with GetButtonDown(name) or GetKeyDown(KeyCode). Project convention: a BepInEx KeyboardShortcut config polled with ZInput.GetKeyDown, gated by the same UI checks as Player.TakeInput (chat, console, inventory, menu, map, text input, dead, teleporting). Adding true rebindable actions to the settings menu needs reflection into m_buttons.

systems.name: Console commands & devcommands
systems.summary: ConsoleCommand constructors self-register into a static dictionary, and later registrations overwrite earlier ones. Vanilla commands are registered once in the private static Terminal.InitTerminal, so mods should add theirs in an InitTerminal postfix. IsValid requires IsCheatsEnabled() = m_cheat && IsServer for cheat commands; remoteCommand commands are forwarded to the server, which checks admin. In 1.0, a cheat command requires confirmcheats and permanently flags the profile (m_usedCheats). The 'test' command, Terminal.m_testList and TryTestFloat/TryTestInt/TryTest give live tuning knobs with no cheat flag.

systems.name: Asset loading & SoftReferenceableAssets
systems.summary: The 1.0 SoftRef system loads bundles from StreamingAssets/SoftRef via a manifest (Runtime.AddManifest must be called before first use; IronGate's manifest format and tooling are not public). Scenes, locations, dungeon rooms, the valkyrie and graphics configs are soft references. Items, pieces, creatures, SEs and recipes remain hard references in ObjectDB/ZNetScene, so adding or cloning them works the classic way (own AssetBundles built with Unity 6000.0.x, clones kept under an inactive DontDestroyOnLoad root). Custom locations and rooms need an AssetID injected into the internal loader (Jotunn-style) or a bypass. Cloned item prefabs may share m_shared with the source, so check before editing.

systems.name: Character / Humanoid / Player / BaseAI & update loops
systems.summary: Character (health, SEMan, movement, damage pipeline Damage → RPC_Damage → ApplyDamage → OnDamaged/CheckDeath) → Humanoid (inventory, equipment, StartAttack, reload virtuals) → Player (local player, stats including adrenaline, action queue with Reload, building, save/load). BaseAI is a sibling component. MonoUpdaters.FixedUpdate batches ZSync*, BaseAI.UpdateAI at a fixed 20 Hz, and Character.CustomFixedUpdate every tick; heavy logic is gated to the owner. Player.FixedUpdate runs owner and local gameplay; Player.Update runs input for all instances, so check the local player. Built-in delegates (m_onDamaged, m_onDeath, etc.) allow patch-free hooks.

systems.name: Dedicated server differences
systems.summary: A separate build (valheim_server.exe; the local install is 1.0.15, network 40). It is headless-only, parses -name/-port/-world/-password/-savedir/-public/-crossplay/-modifier/-setkey etc. and goes straight to the main scene. Its PlayerProfile is empty, and Game.FixedUpdate pins the reference position to (1e6,0,1e6). As a result the server instantiates no world objects, owns nothing, and runs no Character/BaseAI/station components; clients simulate everything. It still stores, saves and routes all ZDOs, owns global keys, time and events, and generates new zones as ghost zones (Awake runs briefly). Server-only mods are limited to handshake, ZDO-level scans, RPC handlers, global keys, world generation and commands; behavioural mods must be on clients.

systems.name: Crossplay (PlayFab)
systems.summary: The -crossplay backend relays traffic through PlayFab, with compression enabled after VersionMatch and higher latency. The handshake adds platform id, block list, crossplay privilege (Error 10) and asynchronous authentication. Matchmaking advertises the game version, network version and modifiers, but no mod info. Xbox, Game Pass and Microsoft Store players cannot practically run BepInEx, so servers that require our mods exclude them. The ISocket API is identical across backends.

systems.name: Logging & debug tooling
systems.summary: ZLog wraps Debug.Log with a timestamp; DevLog is a no-op in retail. The BepInEx config captures Unity logs into BepInEx/LogOutput.log; the Unity Player.log is under LocalLow/IronGate/Valheim. Convention: one ManualLogSource per plugin, debug level gated by config, never log per frame. The in-game test overlay and TryTest* knobs serve live tuning.

systems.name: Official mod surface & built-in extension points
systems.summary: The only official hook is Game.isModded, which shows a menu label, logs at Game.Awake, and makes Achievements.IsCheatedAtAll true. That disables achievements and achievement-bucket stats, and skips the confirmcheats prompt. It is not networked. Other useful non-Harmony extension points: LocationList components merged by ZoneSystem.SetupLocations (locations, vegetation, environments, clutter, events), HasFields per-instance field overrides, session-only ZDO keys, the client→server m_serverSyncedPlayerData channel, lifecycle events (s_onZNetStart, WorldSaveStarted/Finished, SavingStarted/Finished, OnLanguageChange, OnInputLayoutChanged) and per-instance delegates on Character, WearNTear, Destructible, Inventory, ItemDrop and BaseAI.

chapters.notes:
These rules apply to every chapter:
- **Dedicated servers simulate nothing.** Game.FixedUpdate pins the server's reference position to (1e6,0,1e6), so every component-level rule (AI, damage, SEs, stations, building) runs on the client that owns the ZDO. Behavioural mods must be installed on all clients. Server-only mods are limited to the handshake, ZDO scans, RPC handlers, global keys, world generation (ghost zones) and admin commands.
- **Owner-authoritative replication.** ZDOs are replicated whole, and "newer DataRevision wins". Only owners write; everyone else goes through an owner RPC or an ownership hand-off (the Container pattern). The sender id on routed RPCs is spoofable.
- **Where to persist.** Per item: ItemData.m_customData, which survives inventory, containers, the world and item stands, but is lost when stackables merge. Per object: ZDO keys. Sync-only state: session hashes, re-added every session. Per character: Player.m_customData (local only). Per world: global keys.
- **Registration timing.** Use a ZNetScene.Awake prefix plus ObjectDB.Awake/CopyOtherDB postfixes, then re-run UpdateRegisters. Unregistered items are deleted from saves. Duplicate names throw inside vanilla Awake. Prefab names must not contain spaces or '('.
- **No built-in mod handshake.** The network version (40) is a const, so the project needs its own peer-RPC version check. Game.isModded is cosmetic plus log output, but it DISABLES achievements. The user should confirm the policy.
- **Two assumptions flagged for a runtime check:** ItemData.m_shared reference sharing, and whether Instantiate-cloned item prefabs share SharedData with their source.
- **Crossplay.** Xbox and Game Pass players cannot run mods, so any required mod makes a server Steam-only in practice.
- **Crossbow QoL (Combat chapter) worked example.** The loaded state is on Player.m_weaponLoaded plus the ZDO key 'WeaponLoaded', not on the item. Humanoid.UnequipItem → ResetLoadedWeapon clears it. Attack.OnAttackTrigger resets it after a shot. Player.UpdateWeaponLoading queues a reload whenever m_weaponLoaded != the current weapon. Persist a flag in ItemData.m_customData (crossbows are non-stackable) and restore m_weaponLoaded on equip; this is a client-only mod.
- **Environment.** The local dedicated server is 1.0.15 and the client is 1.0.16 (both network 40). The dedicated server's own DLL differs slightly: IsDedicated, arg parsing, and Game.FixedUpdate. I decompiled it separately into the session scratchpad for comparison.
